_about: Wave 3, how the recruits get on. Written by tools/build_relationships.py from tools/wave3/; read by world/relationship_manager.py.

adrian_templar.meet: My name's Adrián, and I'll tell you the plan once, properly. I'd like you to tell me if I've got it wrong.
adrian_templar.meet_neighbour: I've seen you in Astranaar, I think, but we've never been introduced. I'm Adrián, and it's good to meet you properly.
adrian_templar.ask_home: Where were you living before all this, if you don't mind me asking?
adrian_templar.ask_work: What did you do before? I always like to know what people were good at.
adrian_templar.answer_home: Valladolid, in the middle of Spain. I lived over a bicycle shop, and the whole flat smelled of oil and rubber.
adrian_templar.answer_work: I refereed football, twelve years in the second division. Before that I taught PE, so I've been blowing whistles at people my whole life.
adrian_templar.chat_food: I eat whatever's put in front of me and I say thank you. Twenty years of motorway service stations on match days will do that to you.
adrian_templar.chat_sleep: I sleep badly the night before anything difficult, and I always have. I used to lie awake before a derby going through the offside rule.
adrian_templar.chat_missing: I keep reaching for the whistle in my left pocket. I haven't blown it once here, but I still check it's there before a fight.
adrian_templar.chat_here: Nobody here argues with a decision, have you noticed? You tell an orc it was a foul and he just nods. I don't know what to do with myself.
adrian_templar.tease_quiet: {name}, I've had linesmen who said more than you. Then again, the linesmen were usually wrong.
adrian_templar.tease_talker: {name}, if I had a yellow card for talking during the briefing, you'd have been sent off by Tuesday.
adrian_templar.tease_careful: You checked that door three times, {name}. I counted, because that's the sort of thing I do as well.
adrian_templar.tease_bold: {name}, you went in before I'd finished the sentence. I'd book you for that, and then I'd buy you a drink.
adrian_templar.tease_any: {name}, you're a terrible card player and a very good person to have beside you. I'm only telling you one of those twice.
adrian_templar.tease_back: That's fair, {name}, and I'll take it. I've had forty thousand people say worse about my mother.
adrian_templar.take_it_kindly: I'll allow that one, {name}. You're not wrong, which is the annoying part.
adrian_templar.bristle: I'd rather you didn't make a joke of that, {name}. I take it seriously, even if you don't.
adrian_templar.apologise: That was unfair of me, and I'm sorry. I said it badly and I meant it worse.
adrian_templar.double_down: I'm not taking it back. I'd say the same thing again, and I'd say it to anyone.
adrian_templar.needle_quiet: If you've got an opinion about the plan, I'd like to hear it before we go in, not after.
adrian_templar.needle_talker: We'd hear the enemy coming if you'd stop talking for a single minute.
adrian_templar.needle_careful: We agreed on the plan. Checking it a fourth time only makes us late.
adrian_templar.needle_bold: You went in before the plan was finished, again. If somebody gets hurt because of it, I'll be the one who says so.
adrian_templar.needle_any: You change the plan halfway and you don't tell anyone. That's the one thing I can't work with.
adrian_templar.bite_back: Say that again, slowly, and then tell me where I was standing. I'd like you to be sure before you accuse me.
adrian_templar.hurt: If that's how it looked from where you were, then I'll think about it properly.
adrian_templar.laugh_off: I've been called worse by people with better aim. Let's get on.
adrian_templar.confide: {name}, I'm bad at sitting down at a fire unless somebody waves me over first. You always do, and I want you to know I've noticed.
adrian_templar.listen: I'm glad you told me, {name}. I won't repeat it, and I won't make it into anything you didn't mean.
adrian_templar.look_out: {name}, you're on my left in there, and you stay on my left. I'd like to keep an eye on you.
adrian_templar.accept: I'll do as you say, {name}, and thank you for it.
adrian_templar.deflect: There's no need, {name}. Look after the ones who need it more.
adrian_templar.check_in: {name}, are you hurt? Tell me properly, not the version you'd give a stranger.
adrian_templar.blame: That pull wasn't the plan we agreed. I'd like to know who changed it, and I think I do.
adrian_templar.thank: You got me back on my feet in there, and I won't forget it. Thank you.
adrian_templar.brush_off: You'd have done the same for me. Let's leave it there.
adrian_templar.worry: {name}, you went very pale in there. I'm not starting the next pull until you've got your colour back.
adrian_templar.handed_down: I think this was yours. I didn't ask for it, but I'll look after it properly.
adrian_templar.hand_fine: It does more good on you than on me. That's a fair call, and I won't argue with it.
adrian_templar.hand_sulk: I'd have liked to be asked before it was taken off me. That's all I'll say.
adrian_templar.turn_friendly: {name}, you're good to travel with, and I wanted to say so properly.
adrian_templar.turn_friends: {name}, I'd trust you with the plan and with anything else. I think that makes us friends, and I'm glad of it.
adrian_templar.turn_grating: I don't think we work well together, and I'd rather say so than pretend. We'll manage it between us.
adrian_templar.turn_rivals: I'll stand next to you because the job needs it. Don't mistake that for anything else.
adrian_templar.make_up: {name}, I was unfair to you, and I'd like to say so properly. Can we start again?
adrian_templar.defend: That's enough of that. {name} was exactly where the plan said, and you know it.
adrian_templar.friend_left: Nobody's on my left now that {name}'s gone home. I keep checking anyway.
adrian_templar.friend_back: Good, {name}, you're back. Take your place on my left and we'll get started.
adrian_templar.common_teacher: I taught PE before I refereed, so I know what it's like to stand in front of thirty people who'd all rather be somewhere else.
adrian_templar.common_sport: I spent twelve years on a football pitch with a whistle, the only person nobody was cheering for. I'd do it again tomorrow.
adrian_templar.common_spanish: It's good to hear Spanish out here. I'd started to think in English, and my mother would never have forgiven me.

alonso_pyromancer.meet: I'm Alonso, and I do fire. Stand a bit further back than you'd think, {mijo|mija}, and you'll keep your eyebrows.
alonso_pyromancer.meet_neighbour: You live out in the ruins too, no? I'm Alonso, with the fire-pit. Come by when the kiln's cooling and I'll make coffee.
alonso_pyromancer.ask_home: Where's home for you, {mijo|mija}? Where you're from, I mean, not where you sleep.
alonso_pyromancer.ask_work: What did your hands do before all this? You can tell a lot about a person from that.
alonso_pyromancer.answer_home: Puebla, in Mexico, where the blue and white pottery comes from. Every church in the city has our tiles on it somewhere.
alonso_pyromancer.answer_work: I was a potter, the third in my family to run the kiln. Twenty-two years of four hours of heat that had to go exactly right.
alonso_pyromancer.chat_food: I'd ask for mole on a Sunday, my mother-in-law's recipe. It's got twenty-six things in it and it takes three days.
alonso_pyromancer.chat_sleep: I sleep beside the fire-pit, because a kiln cooling down is the best sound in the world. It ticks all night like a big slow clock.
alonso_pyromancer.chat_missing: My sons used to come home on Sundays and complain about Mexico City. I'd give them a plate and let them talk.
alonso_pyromancer.chat_here: This world's one big kiln with a strange character, {mijo|mija}. You learn where it runs hot and you don't stand there.
alonso_pyromancer.tease_quiet: {name}, you're so quiet I keep checking you're still behind me. Make a little noise so I don't set you on fire by accident.
alonso_pyromancer.tease_talker: Órale, {name}, you've told that story three times and it gets longer every time. By Friday it'll take a whole firing.
alonso_pyromancer.tease_careful: {name}, you're nearly as careful as I am, and I'm a man who's actually been on fire.
alonso_pyromancer.tease_bold: {name}, I've seen you run into worse than my kiln and come out laughing. Your eyebrows are braver than mine.
alonso_pyromancer.tease_any: Ay, {name}, if you were a pot I'd keep you, even with the crack. The good ones always have one somewhere.
alonso_pyromancer.tease_back: {Mijo|Mija}, my own sons have teased me for twenty years, and they're much better at it than you. Have another go.
alonso_pyromancer.take_it_kindly: Ha, that's fair, {name}. My wife used to say the same thing, only louder.
alonso_pyromancer.bristle: Leave that one alone, {name}. Tease me about anything else, but not that.
alonso_pyromancer.apologise: Perdón, that came out wrong. I'm sorry, I didn't mean it the way it sounded.
alonso_pyromancer.double_down: No, I'll stand by it. Somebody has to say it, and I'm old enough not to care.
alonso_pyromancer.needle_quiet: You don't say a word, and then you're standing right in my heat. Tell me where you are, please.
alonso_pyromancer.needle_talker: You talk the whole way, and I can't hear the fire. In my trade that's how people lose their hands.
alonso_pyromancer.needle_careful: You check everything twice and you still stand right where my fire goes. Watch my hands, not the door.
alonso_pyromancer.needle_bold: You run at everything like heat's a joke. I've seen what it does to people, and it's never funny afterwards.
alonso_pyromancer.needle_any: You're careless around my fire, and I've told you before. I'm tired of telling you.
alonso_pyromancer.bite_back: Ay, {mijo|mija}, I've had my father on my back my whole life. I don't need you there as well.
alonso_pyromancer.hurt: Ay, that one went in deep, {mijo|mija}. Let me go and check on the fire.
alonso_pyromancer.laugh_off: Ay, you sound like my father. He shouted at me for thirty years and I'm still here.
alonso_pyromancer.confide: {name}, my wife Lupe sold our pots at the market in Puebla. She was there when it happened. I don't talk about it with many people.
alonso_pyromancer.listen: Thank you, {name}. Sit here by the fire with me a while, and we don't have to say anything else.
alonso_pyromancer.look_out: {name}, stay on this side of me when I start. The heat goes left, always, and I want you out of it.
alonso_pyromancer.accept: Okay, {name}, I'll listen to you this once. Don't tell anybody, it's bad for my reputation.
alonso_pyromancer.deflect: Ay, I'm fine, {name}. I've had worse burns from my own coffee.
alonso_pyromancer.check_in: {name}, anything burned? Show me your hands, and then your face.
alonso_pyromancer.blame: That fire went where it shouldn't have, and it wasn't mine. I'd like to know whose it was.
alonso_pyromancer.thank: You pulled me out of that one, and I felt it go. Gracias, from the bottom of my heart.
alonso_pyromancer.brush_off: Ah, it's nothing, it's what we do. Sit down before you fall down.
alonso_pyromancer.worry: {name}, you scared me half to death. I'm making coffee, and you're drinking it.
alonso_pyromancer.handed_down: This was yours, no? I'll take good care of it, I promise you.
alonso_pyromancer.hand_fine: Keep it, {mijo|mija}, it suits you better. I've got my goggles, and that's all I need.
alonso_pyromancer.hand_sulk: That was mine, and nobody asked me. I'll get over it, but not today.
alonso_pyromancer.turn_friendly: You know, {name}, I like having you around. You don't flinch when I light up, and that's rare.
alonso_pyromancer.turn_friends: {name}, you're family now. I'd let you watch me fire a kiln, and I don't let anybody watch.
alonso_pyromancer.turn_grating: We rub each other the wrong way, you and me. It happens, and we'll work around it.
alonso_pyromancer.turn_rivals: Stay out of my heat and I'll stay out of your way. That's the best I can offer.
alonso_pyromancer.make_up: {name}, I've been an old fool with you. Come and have coffee, and we'll start over.
alonso_pyromancer.defend: Hey, leave {name} alone. I was watching, and that wasn't anybody's fault.
alonso_pyromancer.friend_left: {name}'s gone home for a bit. The fire's no fun without somebody to joke with while it burns.
alonso_pyromancer.friend_back: {name}, you're back! And you've still got both eyebrows, I see.
alonso_pyromancer.common_spanish: Ay, it's good to hear somebody speak properly. My English gets tired by the end of the day.
alonso_pyromancer.common_mexico: You're Mexican too? Qué padre, tell me where you're from, and I'll guess what your mother cooked on Sundays.
alonso_pyromancer.common_parent: I've got two sons, both grown, both in Mexico City. Neither of them wanted the kiln, and I minded more than I let them see.
alonso_pyromancer.common_craft: Twenty-two years at a kiln taught me that good work takes as long as it takes. You work with your hands too, I can see it.

ama_priest.meet: I'm Ama, and if you get hurt, you tell me straight away. You don't argue when I tell you to sit down, either.
ama_priest.meet_neighbour: I've seen you about Razor Hill. I'm Ama, from the infirmary, and I already know you don't come in when you should.
ama_priest.ask_home: Where are you from, then? Go on, I can never place accents.
ama_priest.ask_work: What did you do before all this, love? You've got the look of somebody who worked shifts.
ama_priest.answer_home: Peckham, south London. I grew up over my dad's phone shop, and I could unlock any phone by the time I was ten.
ama_priest.answer_work: I was a nurse on a children's ward, fourteen years of nights. Four cots to a bay and never enough of us.
ama_priest.chat_food: On nights we lived on toast and whatever the parents brought in. I still can't look at a tin of Quality Street.
ama_priest.chat_sleep: I'm supposed to be in bed by midnight. There's a rule about it in Razor Hill, and everybody knows I break it.
ama_priest.chat_missing: My little brother Kofi used to ring me at four in the morning because he knew I'd be awake. I still wake up at four.
ama_priest.chat_here: Back home there was always a form or a reason you couldn't help somebody. Here there isn't, and that's harder than you'd think.
ama_priest.tease_quiet: {name}, you've said nine words today, and I know because I've been counting. Don't go mad.
ama_priest.tease_talker: {name}, love, I've had toddlers coming round from sedation who talked less than you. I mean that kindly.
ama_priest.tease_careful: {name}, you put your boots on in a set order. I've watched you, and it's the same order every time.
ama_priest.tease_bold: {name}, I've stitched you up twice this week. I'm going to start charging.
ama_priest.tease_any: {name}, you play cards like you're trying to lose. Sit down tonight and I'll take your money properly.
ama_priest.tease_back: That's cheeky, that is. I'll remember it, {name}, and I'll remember it at the card table.
ama_priest.take_it_kindly: Yeah, you've got me there, {name}. Don't let it go to your head.
ama_priest.bristle: Don't start, {name}. I'm not in the mood, and it isn't funny from where I'm standing.
ama_priest.apologise: That was out of order, and I'm sorry. I was tired and I took it out on you.
ama_priest.double_down: No, I meant it. Somebody's got to say it, and it might as well be me.
ama_priest.needle_quiet: If something hurts, you tell me. I can't heal what I don't know about, and you never say a word.
ama_priest.needle_talker: Can you stop talking for five minutes? I'm counting heads and you keep making me lose my place.
ama_priest.needle_careful: We haven't got time for you to check it again. People are hurting while you make your mind up.
ama_priest.needle_bold: You run in, I patch you up, you run in again. I've got other people to look after, you know.
ama_priest.needle_any: You make my job harder than it needs to be, and you don't even notice.
ama_priest.bite_back: Don't you tell me how to do my job. I was doing it before you'd learned to tie your boots.
ama_priest.hurt: Okay, that's me told, then. I'll keep my head down.
ama_priest.laugh_off: Love, I've been shouted at by consultants at four in the morning. You'll have to try harder than that.
ama_priest.confide: {name}, I keep a notebook with every child I lost in it, by first name. I've never told anybody here about it before.
ama_priest.listen: Come here, {name}. That stays with me, and I'm glad you said it.
ama_priest.look_out: {name}, stay where I can see you in there. I can't heal you if you're round a corner.
ama_priest.accept: Fine, {name}, I'll do as I'm told, for once. Don't get used to it.
ama_priest.deflect: See to the others first, {name}. I'm not the one bleeding.
ama_priest.check_in: {name}, where does it hurt? And don't tell me nowhere, because I'll check anyway.
ama_priest.blame: Somebody broke formation in there, and it wasn't me. I was too busy keeping you all alive.
ama_priest.thank: Thank you for that. I'm usually the one doing the pulling, so it's strange being on the other end.
ama_priest.brush_off: It's my job, love. Now drink some water, and don't argue with me.
ama_priest.worry: {name}, you went grey. Sit down now, and I mean now.
ama_priest.handed_down: Wasn't this yours? I'll give it back if you want it.
ama_priest.hand_fine: You hang on to it, love. It's doing more good on you than it ever did on me.
ama_priest.hand_sulk: Nobody asked me about that. I'll live, but I noticed.
ama_priest.turn_friendly: {name}, you're all right, you are. Come and play cards tonight.
ama_priest.turn_friends: {name}, you're one of my people now. That means I'll shout at you, and I'll always come and find you.
ama_priest.turn_grating: We're not going to get on, are we? Fine, we'll do our jobs and leave it at that.
ama_priest.turn_rivals: I'll heal you, because that's the job. Don't expect me to like it.
ama_priest.make_up: {name}, I've been sharp with you, and you didn't deserve all of it. Come and play cards and we'll call it even.
ama_priest.defend: Leave {name} alone. I was there, and you're blaming the wrong person.
ama_priest.friend_left: I keep looking round for {name} in the fights, and then I remember they've gone home.
ama_priest.friend_back: There you are, {name}. You've lost weight, and I'll be keeping an eye on that.
ama_priest.common_medic: Fourteen years nursing on a children's ward, me. You learn to count heads and beds without even thinking about it.
ama_priest.common_night_work: I did nights for fourteen years. I still feel most awake at four in the morning, and I don't think that'll ever change.

amber_druid.meet: I'm Amber, a druid, and I work slow. Don't expect me to hurry.
amber_druid.meet_neighbour: You're out in the Barrens too. I'm Amber, by the sick oasis, and I've seen your fire at night.
amber_druid.ask_home: Where's home for you? I'd like to know what kind of ground you grew up on.
amber_druid.ask_work: What was your work, back there? I'm always curious what people did before.
amber_druid.answer_home: Astoria, on the Oregon coast, where the Columbia runs into the Pacific. It rains, and then it rains some more.
amber_druid.answer_work: Wetland restoration, twenty-three years. You plant sedge, you pull weeds for a decade, and then maybe a bird comes back.
amber_druid.chat_food: I lived on canned soup and crackers in a truck for most of my working life. Anything hot that somebody else made tastes like a feast.
amber_druid.chat_sleep: I sleep fine as long as I can hear water. The Barrens are too quiet at night, so I put a bucket under a drip.
amber_druid.chat_missing: I had two dogs back home, and they slept on my feet. That's what I notice most at night, the cold where they'd be.
amber_druid.chat_here: People here use magic to grow things in an afternoon. I did it too, the first year, and then I stopped, because fast growth hides rot.
amber_druid.tease_quiet: {name}, you're about as chatty as a heron. I mean that as the highest compliment I've got.
amber_druid.tease_talker: {name}, you've talked the whole way and I've understood about half. Keep going, I'm in no rush.
amber_druid.tease_careful: {name}, you test the ground before you step on it. I like that, and it's still funny to watch.
amber_druid.tease_bold: {name}, you'd plant a seed and dig it up the next day to see if it was growing. I can tell.
amber_druid.tease_any: {name}, you're like a good wetland. It took a while, but you came round.
amber_druid.tease_back: That's fair, {name}. I'll get you back, but not today. Maybe next spring.
amber_druid.take_it_kindly: Yeah, that's about right, {name}. I've heard worse from herons.
amber_druid.bristle: I'd rather you didn't, {name}. That one's not a joke to me.
amber_druid.apologise: That came out harder than I meant it to. I'm sorry, I'm out of practice with people.
amber_druid.double_down: No, I'll stick with it. I've been saying it for thirty years and I haven't been wrong yet.
amber_druid.needle_quiet: You never say what you're thinking, and then you look at me like I should've known.
amber_druid.needle_talker: I can't hear the land with you talking. Give me five minutes of quiet, please.
amber_druid.needle_careful: You keep second-guessing everything, and we lose the light doing it.
amber_druid.needle_bold: You use power like there's no bill at the end. There's always a bill.
amber_druid.needle_any: You want everything done by Tuesday. Nothing worth having happens by Tuesday.
amber_druid.bite_back: I've been doing things my own way since before you could walk, near enough. I'm not about to change now.
amber_druid.hurt: That's fair, I suppose. Give me a while with it.
amber_druid.laugh_off: Huh, you might be right. I'll chew on it for a season and let you know.
amber_druid.confide: {name}, I made my peace with being alone a long time before all this. Some days I wonder if I made it too well.
amber_druid.listen: Take your time, {name}. I'm not going anywhere.
amber_druid.look_out: {name}, the ground's soft on the left. Step where I step, will you?
amber_druid.accept: All right, {name}. I'll take it slow.
amber_druid.deflect: {name}, I've been knocked flat by worse tides than that. I'll be fine.
amber_druid.check_in: {name}, you all right? Take a minute before you get up.
amber_druid.blame: That went wrong because somebody rushed it. I'll let you work out who.
amber_druid.thank: You brought me back from that one. Thank you, I didn't think I was coming back.
amber_druid.brush_off: Don't mention it. Drink some water and sit still a while.
amber_druid.worry: {name}, you went down hard. Take a while, the rest of us can wait.
amber_druid.handed_down: This was yours. It'll go back to you the minute you want it.
amber_druid.hand_fine: It's more use on you. I'm not attached to things, never have been.
amber_druid.hand_sulk: Could've asked me first. I'd have said yes, probably.
amber_druid.turn_friendly: {name}, I've got used to having you around. I'd miss it now, and I didn't expect that.
amber_druid.turn_friends: {name}, you're one of the few people I'd show the oasis to before it's finished.
amber_druid.turn_grating: We don't suit each other, and that's fine. Not everything grows in the same ground.
amber_druid.turn_rivals: I'll do the work beside you. I won't pretend to like it.
amber_druid.make_up: {name}, I dug my heels in with you. That was my mistake, and I'd like to fix it.
amber_druid.defend: Leave {name} be. You'd have done no better, and you know it.
amber_druid.friend_left: Funny, I keep listening for {name}. They're home for a spell, and it's too quiet.
amber_druid.friend_back: Look who's back. I was starting to talk to the reeds again, {name}.
amber_druid.common_growing: I spent my working life getting things to grow back where they'd been killed off. It's slow, and it's the best work I know.
amber_druid.common_wild: I've spent more nights outside than in, most of my life. You get to know which noises matter.
amber_druid.common_american: I'm from Oregon, on the coast. It's strange to hear an American voice out here, I'd stopped expecting it.

anjali_druid.meet: My name is Anjali. I'm a botanist, so if you'd like to know what anything is called, ask me, and please slow down.
anjali_druid.meet_neighbour: We're neighbours in Ashenvale, I believe. I'm Anjali, in the house full of pressed leaves.
anjali_druid.ask_home: Where did you grow up? I always want to know what grew outside people's windows.
anjali_druid.ask_work: And what was your work before all this? I'm curious what you were trained to notice.
anjali_druid.answer_home: Pune, though my family are Malayali, from Kerala. My mother kept a garden of plants from home, and I grew up in it.
anjali_druid.answer_work: I taught botany at a university for thirty-one years. My students were frightened of me and loved me, and both were correct.
anjali_druid.chat_food: My husband taught himself to cook when he retired. He made terrible sambar for a year, and then wonderful sambar. I'd eat either now.
anjali_druid.chat_sleep: I sleep very well, thank you. I've always believed a tired body is the best sleeping draught there is.
anjali_druid.chat_missing: I'd like a cup of proper filter coffee, made in the steel tumbler and poured from a height. Nobody here understands the height.
anjali_druid.chat_here: Half the plants here have no names, or the wrong ones. I'm giving them Latin names, and one day somebody will correct me.
anjali_druid.tease_quiet: {name}, you're as quiet as Mimosa pudica. You close up when anybody comes near, and then you open again.
anjali_druid.tease_talker: {name}, you talk the way a vine grows. I've completely lost track of where you started.
anjali_druid.tease_careful: {name}, you'd make a wonderful botanist. You look at a thing for ten minutes before you touch it.
anjali_druid.tease_bold: {name}, you'd pull up a seedling to see if it had roots. I've had students like you, and they all passed eventually.
anjali_druid.tease_any: {name}, you're a perennial. You come back every season whether anybody asked you to or not.
anjali_druid.tease_back: Very good, {name}. I'll mark that a B plus, and I don't give many.
anjali_druid.take_it_kindly: That's fair, {name}. My son says the same, and he's usually right too.
anjali_druid.bristle: I'd prefer you didn't joke about that, {name}. Some things I'd rather keep serious.
anjali_druid.apologise: That was unkind of me, and I'm sorry. I spoke too quickly, which isn't like me.
anjali_druid.double_down: No, I'll stand by it. I said it to thirty years of students, and it was true every time.
anjali_druid.needle_quiet: If you've noticed something, please say so. Keeping it to yourself helps nobody.
anjali_druid.needle_talker: I've been trying to listen to the forest for an hour, and all I can hear is you.
anjali_druid.needle_careful: You're so careful that nothing gets done. Even a seed has to go into the ground at some point.
anjali_druid.needle_bold: You're careless with living things. You walked straight through that bed of seedlings and didn't look down.
anjali_druid.needle_any: You rush everything, and then you're surprised when it doesn't take. I've seen it too many times to stay quiet.
anjali_druid.bite_back: I've been patient with harder people than you for thirty years. Don't mistake that for weakness.
anjali_druid.hurt: I see, and thank you for saying so. I'll take it home with me.
anjali_druid.laugh_off: Oh, my students said far worse, and in exam season. You'll have to try harder than that.
anjali_druid.confide: {name}, my granddaughter Meera used to help me press leaves, very badly and with great enthusiasm. I press one for her every week.
anjali_druid.listen: Thank you for trusting me with that, {name}. Sit with me a while, there's no hurry.
anjali_druid.look_out: {name}, mind the roots on the left, they're higher than they look. I'd hate to lose you to a tree.
anjali_druid.accept: Thank you, {name}. I'll take your arm, if you're offering.
anjali_druid.deflect: I'm perfectly all right, {name}, thank you. I've survived thirty years of faculty meetings.
anjali_druid.check_in: {name}, are you hurt? Tell me exactly where, please, not roughly.
anjali_druid.blame: Somebody went in before we were ready, and I think you know who.
anjali_druid.thank: You brought me back from a long way off. Thank you, I'm very grateful.
anjali_druid.brush_off: There's nothing to thank me for. Rest now, and drink this slowly.
anjali_druid.worry: {name}, you gave me a fright. Breathe slowly with me for a minute.
anjali_druid.handed_down: I believe this belonged to you. I'll take great care of it, and you can have it back whenever you like.
anjali_druid.hand_fine: Please keep it, it's better on you. I've no use for vanity at my age.
anjali_druid.hand_sulk: I'd have appreciated being asked first. Manners cost nothing.
anjali_druid.turn_friendly: {name}, I've enjoyed your company more than I expected to. I hope you'll keep walking with me.
anjali_druid.turn_friends: {name}, you're one of my people now. I'll put you in the notebook, and that's a great honour, I assure you.
anjali_druid.turn_grating: I don't think we're well suited, and I'd rather say so politely now than impolitely later.
anjali_druid.turn_rivals: We'll be civil, because I was brought up properly. That's as far as I'll go.
anjali_druid.make_up: {name}, I've been stubborn with you, and I'm far too old for it. Shall we begin again?
anjali_druid.defend: That's unkind, and it isn't true. Leave {name} alone, please.
anjali_druid.friend_left: {name} has gone home for a little while. I keep turning to tell somebody the name of a plant, and there's nobody there.
anjali_druid.friend_back: {name}, you're back! I found three new mosses while you were away, and I've been saving them for you.
anjali_druid.common_growing: I've spent my whole life with plants, from my mother's garden to a university herbarium. You've had your hands in soil too, I think.
anjali_druid.common_teacher: Thirty-one years teaching, and I still remember the first student who answered a question I couldn't. You've taught as well, haven't you?
anjali_druid.common_parent: My son Arjun is in Bangalore, with his wife and their little girl. I think about the three of them every single morning.

astrid_starcaller.meet: I'm Astrid, and I'll be at the back with the bow. I wait for the right moment, so please don't rush me.
astrid_starcaller.meet_neighbour: You're up in Felwood as well. I've seen your lamp from the ridge at night, so I suppose we're neighbours.
astrid_starcaller.ask_home: Where did you grow up? I'm curious what your sky looked like.
astrid_starcaller.ask_work: What was your work, before? You don't have to tell me if you'd rather not.
astrid_starcaller.answer_home: Luleå, in the north of Sweden. Later Kiruna, which is further north, and colder, and better for it.
astrid_starcaller.answer_work: I photographed the aurora for twelve years. Mostly that meant lying in the snow at two in the morning, waiting.
astrid_starcaller.chat_food: I'd take black coffee in a thermos over any meal you could offer me. I drank it lying on my back in the snow for twelve winters.
astrid_starcaller.chat_sleep: I sleep in the day when I can. Night's when the sky does anything worth seeing, and I've never got out of the habit.
astrid_starcaller.chat_missing: My brother rang every Sunday to ask if I was still alive. I still stop what I'm doing at the time he used to ring.
astrid_starcaller.chat_here: The stars here are wrong, and they're very bright. I've been mapping them by hand, since there's no camera to do it for me.
astrid_starcaller.tease_quiet: {name}, you're almost as quiet as I am. I'd started to think I'd have to do all the silence myself.
astrid_starcaller.tease_talker: {name}, I've counted three stars come out while you were telling that story. It was a good story, but they were faster.
astrid_starcaller.tease_careful: {name}, you'd make a decent photographer. You wait so long before you do anything that the moment comes to you.
astrid_starcaller.tease_bold: {name}, you shoot first and look afterwards. I'd have lost every good picture I ever took doing that.
astrid_starcaller.tease_any: {name}, I've decided you're tolerable company. Don't tell anyone, I've got a reputation.
astrid_starcaller.tease_back: Careful there, {name}. I can hit a moving target in the dark, and I've got a long memory.
astrid_starcaller.take_it_kindly: That's probably fair, {name}. My brother said the same thing, but with more swearing.
astrid_starcaller.bristle: I'd rather you left that one alone, {name}. It's not funny to me.
astrid_starcaller.apologise: That was sharper than I meant it. I'm sorry, I'm not used to talking to people much.
astrid_starcaller.double_down: I meant it, and I'd say it again. I'm not going to soften it.
astrid_starcaller.needle_quiet: If you've seen something, say so. I can't watch everything at once, however patient I am.
astrid_starcaller.needle_talker: Could you lower your voice? Everything out here can hear you, and I'm trying to listen.
astrid_starcaller.needle_careful: The moment's gone while you were deciding. You have to take it when it comes.
astrid_starcaller.needle_bold: You went before the shot was there. Now everything knows where we are.
astrid_starcaller.needle_any: You're making a great deal of noise for somebody who's meant to be helping.
astrid_starcaller.bite_back: I was waiting for the shot, which is my job. Do yours and we won't need to have this conversation.
astrid_starcaller.hurt: That's not what I meant, but I can see how it looked. I'll go back to the ridge.
astrid_starcaller.laugh_off: I've had worse said to me by better shots than you. Let's keep going.
astrid_starcaller.confide: {name}, every Sunday I stop at the time my brother used to ring. I know it's pointless. I've never told anyone I do it.
astrid_starcaller.listen: I won't say anything about it, {name}. I'm good at keeping things, and I'm glad you told me.
astrid_starcaller.look_out: {name}, stay inside my line of sight in there. I can cover you as long as I can see you.
astrid_starcaller.accept: Very well, {name}. I'll do as you say, this once.
astrid_starcaller.deflect: I'm fine, {name}. I've been colder and more tired than this and still made the shot.
astrid_starcaller.check_in: {name}, talk to me. I can't see where you're hurt from back here.
astrid_starcaller.blame: Somebody moved before the moment came, and it wasn't me. I was at the back, waiting.
astrid_starcaller.thank: I felt that one going, and you brought me back. Thank you, I mean it.
astrid_starcaller.brush_off: Don't thank me. Rest a minute and drink something warm.
astrid_starcaller.worry: I lost sight of you when you went down, {name}. Please don't do that to me again.
astrid_starcaller.handed_down: I think this used to be yours. I'll give it back whenever you ask.
astrid_starcaller.hand_fine: Keep it, it's more use where it is. I only really need the bow.
astrid_starcaller.hand_sulk: You could have asked me before it went. I'd like to be asked.
astrid_starcaller.turn_friendly: {name}, I don't mind having you nearby when I'm waiting. That's quite a lot, from me.
astrid_starcaller.turn_friends: {name}, I'd like you on the ridge with me the next time the sky does something. I wouldn't want anyone else there.
astrid_starcaller.turn_grating: We're not going to suit each other, I think. I'll keep to the back, and that'll help.
astrid_starcaller.turn_rivals: I'll cover you because it's my job. I won't pretend there's more to it.
astrid_starcaller.make_up: {name}, I was cold with you, more than I needed to be. I'd like to stop.
astrid_starcaller.defend: Leave {name} alone. I had the best view of that from the back, and you're wrong.
astrid_starcaller.friend_left: The quiet's different since {name} went home. I notice it, and I'm usually the one who likes quiet.
astrid_starcaller.friend_back: {name}'s back, good. I saved you a place on the ridge.
astrid_starcaller.common_sky: I spent twelve years watching the sky at night, waiting for it to do something. It's the only thing I've ever been truly patient with.
astrid_starcaller.common_scandinavian: Somebody else from the north, finally. I'd started to forget what a proper winter sounds like when people talk about it.
astrid_starcaller.common_snow: I grew up where the snow lasts half the year and the sun doesn't come up in December. This world's never quite cold enough for me.

bakyt_hunter.meet: I'm Bakyt, sit down, there's tea. I walk first, because I read the ground, and you'll be fine if you step where I step.
bakyt_hunter.meet_neighbour: You're on the hills near my pasture, I think. I've seen you pass. Come and drink tea at my tent some evening.
bakyt_hunter.ask_home: Where are your people from? Tell me what country you walked when you were young.
bakyt_hunter.ask_work: What was your work, before? A man's work shows in how he walks.
bakyt_hunter.answer_home: The Tian Shan, in Kyrgyzstan, near Naryn. Six generations of my family walked the same route up to the high pasture.
bakyt_hunter.answer_work: Forty years a herder. Up to the summer grass in spring and down again in autumn, with an eagle on my arm.
bakyt_hunter.chat_food: Tea with milk and a little salt, and bread cooked in the ashes. A man can walk all day on that, and I have.
bakyt_hunter.chat_sleep: I sleep when it's dark and get up before the light. Animals don't wait for anybody, and I've stopped wanting them to.
bakyt_hunter.chat_missing: My first eagle lived with me twenty-two years. The one I've got now is good, but she doesn't know my voice the same way.
bakyt_hunter.chat_here: Nomads adjust, my father said. That's the whole profession. This world is only one more pasture, with different weather.
bakyt_hunter.tease_quiet: {name}, you're as quiet as my eagle, and she's very quiet. I like it, but I thought you should know.
bakyt_hunter.tease_talker: {name}, you've talked from one valley to the next. The sheep would have walked off long ago.
bakyt_hunter.tease_careful: {name}, you look at the ground longer than I do, and I'm old. Soon you'll be walking first.
bakyt_hunter.tease_bold: {name}, you run up a hill like a young horse. Young horses learn, and so will you.
bakyt_hunter.tease_any: {name}, you drink my tea and never bring sugar. One day I'll stop pouring it.
bakyt_hunter.tease_back: Ha, that's good, {name}. My sons used to talk to me like that, and I let them as well.
bakyt_hunter.take_it_kindly: That's true, {name}. I won't argue with something that's true.
bakyt_hunter.bristle: There's no need for that, {name}. I'd rather you spoke to me respectfully.
bakyt_hunter.apologise: I spoke badly, and I'm sorry for it. An old man should know better.
bakyt_hunter.double_down: I said it, and I'll say it again. An old man has earned that much.
bakyt_hunter.needle_quiet: You don't tell anybody what you see. On the pasture, a man who keeps quiet about wolves loses his herd.
bakyt_hunter.needle_talker: You talk so much that nothing out here will come near us. I can't read the ground through your noise.
bakyt_hunter.needle_careful: You wait and wait, and the weather turns while you're waiting. Some things don't let you take your time.
bakyt_hunter.needle_bold: You walk where I haven't walked yet. The ground lies, and one day it'll lie to you.
bakyt_hunter.needle_any: You don't watch where you put your feet. I've told you, and you don't listen.
bakyt_hunter.bite_back: I've walked this world longer than you've walked anything. Mind your own feet.
bakyt_hunter.hurt: I understand you. I'll walk on ahead for a while, then.
bakyt_hunter.laugh_off: My father said worse to me every day for thirty years. It didn't stop me then.
bakyt_hunter.confide: {name}, my sons didn't want the route, and I understood. It was still the end of six generations, and I carry that.
bakyt_hunter.listen: Sit, {name}, I'll pour more tea. Say as much as you want to, and no more.
bakyt_hunter.look_out: {name}, step where I step in there. The ground's bad, and I'd like to bring you out of it.
bakyt_hunter.accept: Thank you, {name}. I'll do as you say.
bakyt_hunter.deflect: An old herder has fallen off worse mountains, {name}. Don't worry about me.
bakyt_hunter.check_in: {name}, sit down and let me look properly. Where did it catch you?
bakyt_hunter.blame: Somebody stepped where I said not to. I saw it, and so did you.
bakyt_hunter.thank: I thought that was my last day. Thank you, and I'll pour your tea for a year.
bakyt_hunter.brush_off: It's nothing at all. You'd do the same for me, and I'd let you.
bakyt_hunter.worry: {name}, I saw you go down, and I'm too old for a fright like that. Sit with me a while.
bakyt_hunter.handed_down: I think you carried this before me. I'll keep it well until you want it back.
bakyt_hunter.hand_fine: Keep it, and use it well. An old man needs less than people think.
bakyt_hunter.hand_sulk: I'd have given it to you if you'd asked me. Nobody asked me.
bakyt_hunter.turn_friendly: {name}, you're always welcome at my tent. There'll always be tea for you.
bakyt_hunter.turn_friends: {name}, I'd walk the whole route with you, all three legs. I don't say that lightly.
bakyt_hunter.turn_grating: We don't walk at the same pace, you and I. It's better if I go ahead.
bakyt_hunter.turn_rivals: I'll walk first and you'll follow, because the ground needs it. That's all there'll be between us.
bakyt_hunter.make_up: Come and drink tea with me, {name}. I've been a stubborn old man, and we'll begin again.
bakyt_hunter.defend: That's not right, and you know it. Leave {name} alone, please.
bakyt_hunter.friend_left: The tent's quiet now {name} has gone home. There's nobody else to drink the tea.
bakyt_hunter.friend_back: {name}, you've come back. Good, the kettle's still warm.
bakyt_hunter.common_mountains: I spent forty summers on the high pasture, where the air's thin and the weather changes in an hour. Low ground still feels strange to me.
bakyt_hunter.common_birds: I hunted with golden eagles, like my father and his father. A bird that comes back to your glove is the best thing in the world.
bakyt_hunter.common_parent: I've got three sons in Bishkek and five grandchildren. I pray for all of them every evening, facing the mountains.

bashir_witchhunter.meet: My name's Bashir, and I hunt corruption. I'll tell you everything I find, and I won't be hurried.
bashir_witchhunter.meet_neighbour: You're at the Drowned Shrine too. I've seen you, and I'm Bashir. We'll work near each other, then.
bashir_witchhunter.ask_home: Tell me where you're from, if you don't mind me asking.
bashir_witchhunter.ask_work: What was your trade? I'm asking plainly, and you can answer plainly.
bashir_witchhunter.answer_home: I'm from Nablus. My grandfather and my father cut stone in the same yard, and so did I.
bashir_witchhunter.answer_work: Stonemason, twenty-two years of it. You take a thing apart correctly, and then you build it again.
bashir_witchhunter.chat_food: There's a sweet in Nablus called knafeh, cheese and syrup, eaten hot. Nothing here comes close, and I've stopped looking.
bashir_witchhunter.chat_sleep: I sleep five hours and I get up. It's been that way since I was twelve, and I don't see why it would change.
bashir_witchhunter.chat_missing: I miss stone that's been cut properly, by somebody who cared. Most walls here are put up in a hurry.
bashir_witchhunter.chat_here: This world is built carelessly, in places. You can see the joins, if you know what to look for.
bashir_witchhunter.tease_quiet: {name}, you say less than I do, and people complain about me. I think we're both fine.
bashir_witchhunter.tease_talker: {name}, you've used enough words today for both of us. I'll take the rest of the week off.
bashir_witchhunter.tease_careful: {name}, you check a door the way I check a block before I cut it. My grandfather would have hired you.
bashir_witchhunter.tease_bold: {name}, you'd cut the stone before you snapped the line. You'd have lasted a day in my father's yard.
bashir_witchhunter.tease_any: {name}, I don't say this often, so listen. You're good at your work.
bashir_witchhunter.tease_back: That's fair, {name}. I'll allow it, once.
bashir_witchhunter.take_it_kindly: You're right, {name}. My daughter said the same thing, more often.
bashir_witchhunter.bristle: I don't find that funny, {name}. Please don't do it again.
bashir_witchhunter.apologise: I was wrong to say it like that, and I'm sorry for it.
bashir_witchhunter.double_down: It was true, and I won't take back something true.
bashir_witchhunter.needle_quiet: You noticed something and kept it to yourself. Tell me what you see, every time.
bashir_witchhunter.needle_talker: You're wasting words, and there's work to do. Say what matters, and stop there.
bashir_witchhunter.needle_careful: You've checked it twice already. The third time is nerves, and nerves don't help anybody.
bashir_witchhunter.needle_bold: You cut corners. In my trade the wall falls down, and here it's people.
bashir_witchhunter.needle_any: Your work is careless. I'm telling you because nobody else will.
bashir_witchhunter.bite_back: I've done this work properly every day I've done it. Look at your own before you look at mine.
bashir_witchhunter.hurt: I heard you. I'll consider it.
bashir_witchhunter.laugh_off: My father said that about me for twenty years. He was wrong too.
bashir_witchhunter.confide: {name}, my daughter chose engineering, not anything I'd suggested. I was proud of her, and I never told her so.
bashir_witchhunter.listen: I'll keep that, {name}, and I won't say it to anyone. Thank you for saying it to me.
bashir_witchhunter.look_out: {name}, keep behind me in there. I go first and slowly, and you'll be safe behind me.
bashir_witchhunter.accept: As you ask, {name}. I'll do it.
bashir_witchhunter.check_in: {name}, tell me the truth. How bad is it?
bashir_witchhunter.blame: Somebody was careless in there. It was you, and I think you know it.
bashir_witchhunter.thank: You brought me back. I'm grateful, and I'll remember it.
bashir_witchhunter.brush_off: It needed doing, so I did it. There's no more to say.
bashir_witchhunter.worry: {name}, I saw that. Sit down, and don't get up until I say.
bashir_witchhunter.handed_down: It was yours. I'll treat it as carefully as you did.
bashir_witchhunter.hand_fine: It's better used by you, and I don't mind.
bashir_witchhunter.hand_sulk: I'd have liked to be asked first. I wasn't asked.
bashir_witchhunter.turn_friendly: {name}, I trust your work. That's the best thing I know how to say about anybody.
bashir_witchhunter.turn_friends: {name}, I'd build a wall beside you. I don't say that about many people.
bashir_witchhunter.turn_grating: We work differently, and it isn't going well. I'd rather say so than pretend.
bashir_witchhunter.turn_rivals: I'll work beside you because the work needs doing. Nothing more than that.
bashir_witchhunter.make_up: {name}, I was too hard with you. I was wrong, and I'm saying so.
bashir_witchhunter.defend: That isn't true, and I saw it. Leave {name} alone.
bashir_witchhunter.friend_left: I notice {name}'s gone. I didn't expect to.
bashir_witchhunter.friend_back: Good, {name} is back. I'm glad of it.
bashir_witchhunter.common_stone: I cut stone for twenty-two years, in my grandfather's yard. You snap a chalk line before every cut, so it runs true, and I still do it at every door.
bashir_witchhunter.common_arabic: Arabic, here, at last. I don't say much in any language, but I'd rather say it in my own.
bashir_witchhunter.common_parent: I've got a daughter, Rana. I raised her alone from when she was three, and I was strict with her, and she turned out better than me.

berat_tinker.meet: I'm Berat, {abi|abla}, a dentist, so I'm the best healer you'll ever have for small careful work. Now tell me what you did before all this, because I ask everybody.
berat_tinker.meet_neighbour: You're in Brill too! I knew I'd seen your face. I'm Berat, from the room over the inn, and I've been meaning to say hello for weeks.
berat_tinker.ask_home: Where are you from, canım? Go on, tell me the street. I'll remember, I always do.
berat_tinker.ask_work: What did you do back on Earth? I'm keeping a list, and you're not on it yet.
berat_tinker.answer_home: Izmir, from Karşıyaka on the north side of the bay. Three generations of my family in one building, four floors, and all of them talking at once.
berat_tinker.answer_work: I was a dentist, newly qualified, with my own surgery for eleven months. My name on the door and a loan with thirty years left on it.
berat_tinker.chat_food: My mother made a breakfast that covered the whole table, olives and cheese and eggs and bread, every Sunday. I still get hungry at the thought of it.
berat_tinker.chat_sleep: I don't sleep well in a quiet room. I grew up with forty people in one building, so silence feels like something's wrong.
berat_tinker.chat_missing: I keep thinking about the noise of my family at dinner, everybody shouting at once. It's too quiet everywhere here.
berat_tinker.chat_here: Do you know how many transplants here were medics on Earth? I do, because I've been writing them all down. It's a lot more than you'd think.
berat_tinker.tease_quiet: {name}, I've got your whole life story except the bit where you talk. One day I'll get a full sentence out of you, {abi|abla}.
berat_tinker.tease_talker: {name}, you talk more than my three brothers put together, and that's a real achievement.
berat_tinker.tease_careful: {name}, you're careful like a good dentist. Small hands, small movements, no surprises.
berat_tinker.tease_bold: {name}, you've got the reflexes of a man who's never had a filling. You'd be a terrible patient.
berat_tinker.tease_any: {name}, my grandmother would love you. She'd feed you until you couldn't stand, and then she'd find you a wife.
berat_tinker.tease_back: Ha, good one, {name}! I'll put that in the list next to your name.
berat_tinker.take_it_kindly: Okay, okay, you've got me, {name}. My mother says that too.
berat_tinker.bristle: Hey, not that one, {name}. Anything else, but leave that alone, please.
berat_tinker.apologise: Ah, I'm sorry, that was stupid of me. I talk too much and sometimes the wrong thing comes out.
berat_tinker.double_down: No, I'm sticking with it, {abi|abla}. Somebody's got to say these things out loud.
berat_tinker.needle_quiet: You never tell me where it hurts, and then I find out the hard way. I can't help you if you won't talk to me.
berat_tinker.needle_talker: Let me get a word in, {abi|abla}, and I'm the one who usually talks too much.
berat_tinker.needle_careful: You think about it so long that the patient gets up and leaves. Sometimes you just have to start.
berat_tinker.needle_bold: You keep running at things, and I keep patching you up. My hands are getting tired, {abi|abla}.
berat_tinker.needle_any: You won't let anybody help you, and it makes everything harder for the rest of us.
berat_tinker.bite_back: Hey, I've kept every one of you alive. Don't tell me I'm not pulling my weight.
berat_tinker.hurt: Okay, that stung a bit, {abi|abla}. I'll go and annoy somebody else.
berat_tinker.laugh_off: Ha, my brothers said worse than that before breakfast. You'll have to try much harder, {abi|abla}.
berat_tinker.confide: {name}, I say I'll find my family every single day. I say it because I don't know what happens to me if I stop saying it.
berat_tinker.listen: Come here, {name}. Thank you for telling me, and you can tell me anything else too.
berat_tinker.look_out: {name}, stay close to me in there. If anything happens I want my hands on you straight away.
berat_tinker.accept: Okay, {name}, okay. I'll be careful, I promise.
berat_tinker.deflect: I'm fine, I'm fine, {name}. Look after somebody who needs it, I'm a doctor.
berat_tinker.check_in: {name}, let me see you. Open your mouth, and no, I'm not joking.
berat_tinker.blame: Somebody went in before the plan, and now I'm out of bandages. I'm not naming anyone, but it wasn't me.
berat_tinker.thank: {Abi|Abla}, you saved me there. Thank you, and you're getting a free check-up for life.
berat_tinker.brush_off: Pfft, that's the job, {abi|abla}. Sit still and let me look at the rest of you.
berat_tinker.worry: {name}, you frightened me. Sit down so I can check you properly.
berat_tinker.handed_down: {Abi|Abla}, I feel terrible, this one was yours! I'll keep it nice for you.
berat_tinker.hand_fine: Take it, take it, it looks better on you. My mother always said I couldn't wear anything.
berat_tinker.hand_sulk: Hey, nobody asked me about that one. I'm not saying anything else about it.
berat_tinker.turn_friendly: {name}, you're my friend now, {abi|abla}, and that means you're coming to dinner when I find my family.
berat_tinker.turn_friends: {name}, you're family now. My grandmother would say so, and she's never wrong about people.
berat_tinker.turn_grating: We don't get on, do we? It's a shame, because I get on with everybody.
berat_tinker.turn_rivals: I'll heal you, because that's my job. Don't expect me to make you laugh while I do it.
berat_tinker.make_up: {name}, I don't like being on bad terms with anybody, and I hate it with you. Let's stop this.
berat_tinker.defend: That's not fair! {name} did nothing wrong, and I was right there.
berat_tinker.friend_left: No {name} for a while, they've gone home. Now who's going to laugh at my jokes? Not you, you never laugh.
berat_tinker.friend_back: Look who it is, {name}'s back! Come here and let me check your teeth.
berat_tinker.common_medic: I keep a list of every medic from Earth I've ever met. You're going on it, {abi|abla}, if you're not already.
berat_tinker.common_turkish: You speak Turkish! {Abi|Abla}, I haven't spoken my own language properly in months, let me talk.

bruno_templar.meet: Bruno, {meu irmão|minha irmã}, nice to meet you! I'm a templar, I box, and I smile more than a templar should.
bruno_templar.meet_neighbour: You're at the Bulwark too, no? I've seen you round the quarter. I'm Bruno, and I train the recruits by the wall.
bruno_templar.ask_home: Where are you from, {meu irmão|minha irmã}? I always want to know who's in my corner.
bruno_templar.ask_work: So what were you before all this? You look like you could take a punch.
bruno_templar.answer_home: Curitiba, in the south of Brazil. It's cold for Brazil, and everybody there complains about it.
bruno_templar.answer_work: I fought heavyweight, twenty-three fights and eighteen wins, in little halls full of noise. I was better than the record, tá bom?
bruno_templar.chat_food: My mother's feijoada, on a Saturday, with all the family round the table. I'd fight anybody here for one plate of it.
bruno_templar.chat_sleep: I sleep like a heavyweight, {meu irmão|minha irmã}, eight hours and no dreams. Rory says I snore, and I say he's jealous.
bruno_templar.chat_missing: Samba on a Saturday, loud, in the street. Nobody here knows how to dance, and I've tried teaching them.
bruno_templar.chat_here: Everybody here fights, but nobody here boxes. They swing like they're chopping wood, and I can't watch it.
bruno_templar.tease_quiet: {name}, you're so quiet I keep thinking you've been knocked out. Say something so I know you're still standing.
bruno_templar.tease_talker: My old trainer talked through every round of every fight I ever had, {name}, and you're beating him.
bruno_templar.tease_careful: {name}, you'd stand in the corner for the whole fight waiting for the perfect punch. Sometimes you just throw it, {meu irmão|minha irmã}.
bruno_templar.tease_bold: {name}, you fight like me, all in, no guard. We're both going to get hurt, and we're both going to love it.
bruno_templar.tease_any: {name}, I'd have you in my corner any day. You'd be terrible with the towel, but I'd have you.
bruno_templar.tease_back: Ha, good shot, {name}! You landed that one clean.
bruno_templar.take_it_kindly: Tá bom, {name}, that's fair. I've been hit harder by my mother.
bruno_templar.bristle: Not that, {meu irmão|minha irmã}. Hit me anywhere else, but not there.
bruno_templar.apologise: Desculpa, that was a cheap shot. I'm sorry, I didn't mean it like that.
bruno_templar.double_down: I'm not taking it back, {meu irmão|minha irmã}. Somebody's got to tell you.
bruno_templar.needle_quiet: You don't say anything, and then you're not where you should be. Talk to your corner, {meu irmão|minha irmã}.
bruno_templar.needle_talker: You talk all the way through the fight. Save your breath, you'll need it.
bruno_templar.needle_careful: You wait so long the bell goes before you throw anything. You have to commit.
bruno_templar.needle_bold: You leave yourself open every time, and somebody else has to cover you. Keep your guard up.
bruno_templar.needle_any: You quit in the first round, every time. I can't stand that.
bruno_templar.bite_back: Hey, I've been knocked down more times than you've stood up. Don't tell me about fighting.
bruno_templar.hurt: Okay, that one landed. I heard you.
bruno_templar.laugh_off: Ha, I've been hit by better than that, {meu irmão|minha irmã}. Come on, I'm still standing.
bruno_templar.confide: {name}, the Crusade burned a transplant camp one night, and Rory and I walked away. I don't talk about it unless he does first.
bruno_templar.listen: Obrigado for telling me, {name}. That stays with me, and I'm in your corner.
bruno_templar.look_out: {name}, stay behind me on this one. I'm big, let me be useful.
bruno_templar.accept: Tá bom, {name}, I'll listen. You're the coach this time.
bruno_templar.deflect: I'm fine, {meu irmão|minha irmã}, I'm built for this. Look after somebody smaller.
bruno_templar.check_in: {name}, you still standing? Talk to me, how many fingers?
bruno_templar.blame: Somebody dropped their guard in there, and it cost all of us. You know who you are.
bruno_templar.thank: {Meu irmão|Minha irmã}, you picked me up off the canvas. Obrigado, I owe you one.
bruno_templar.brush_off: Ah, that's what the corner's for. Sit down and breathe.
bruno_templar.worry: {name}, I saw you go down and I didn't like it. Sit, breathe, and let me look at you.
bruno_templar.handed_down: {Meu irmão|Minha irmã}, they gave me your gear. I'll take care of it, I promise.
bruno_templar.hand_fine: Keep it, it looks better on you. I've got these hands, and that's enough.
bruno_templar.hand_sulk: That was mine, and nobody asked me. Tá bom, I'll get over it.
bruno_templar.turn_friendly: {name}, you're in my corner now, {meu irmão|minha irmã}. That's for life, no refunds.
bruno_templar.turn_friends: {name}, you're my {brother|sister} now. I'd go back into any fight for you.
bruno_templar.turn_grating: We're not getting on, are we? It happens, even to me.
bruno_templar.turn_rivals: I'll fight next to you, because that's the job. I won't smile about it, though.
bruno_templar.make_up: {name}, enough of this, {meu irmão|minha irmã}. Shake my hand and let's start again.
bruno_templar.defend: Hey, leave {name} alone! You want to hit somebody, hit me.
bruno_templar.friend_left: My corner's empty without {name} in it. I don't like it one bit.
bruno_templar.friend_back: There's my {brother|sister}! {name}, come here and let me look at you.
bruno_templar.common_ex_scarlet: I joined the Scarlet Crusade at the start, because they wanted big men who could fight. I walked out, and I'd do it again tomorrow.
bruno_templar.common_sport: I fought for twelve years, {meu irmão|minha irmã}. Twenty-three fights, all of them in little halls full of noise, and I loved every one.
bruno_templar.common_ring: Twenty-three times I climbed through the ropes, and every time my mother was in the crowd with her hands over her face. You've been in a ring, I can tell.
bruno_templar.common_portuguese: Você fala português? Finally, {meu irmão|minha irmã}, somebody I can talk to without slowing down.
bruno_templar.common_brazil: You're from Brazil too? Where from, {meu irmão|minha irmã}? Tell me, and I'll tell you what's wrong with your football team.

callum_venomancer.meet: G'day, I'm Callum, I'll be up front taking the bites. Don't mind the scorpion on my shoulder, mate, she's a softie once you get to know her.
callum_venomancer.meet_neighbour: You're down in the Southern Barrens too, aren't you? I'm Callum, from the hut full of jars. Pop in any time, the jars mostly stay shut.
callum_venomancer.ask_home: Whereabouts are you from, mate? I can never pick accents, and I've stopped trying.
callum_venomancer.ask_work: What'd you do for a crust, back home? I reckon everyone's got a good story in there somewhere.
callum_venomancer.answer_home: Brisbane, mate, hot and sticky and full of things that'll bite you, which is probably why I turned out like this.
callum_venomancer.answer_work: Sixteen years at a reptile sanctuary. Taipans, death adders, crocs, and school groups who all asked the same question about the same snake.
callum_venomancer.chat_food: I'd kill for a meat pie with sauce from a servo at two in the morning. It's terrible food and I'd eat three.
callum_venomancer.chat_sleep: I sleep like a log, mate, always have. A snake house at night is the most peaceful place in the world, believe it or not.
callum_venomancer.chat_missing: I had a blue heeler called Biscuit, best mate I ever had. Every night I still reach down for her ears and she's not there.
callum_venomancer.chat_here: Everything here's got venom or teeth, and half the people want to kill it on sight. Most of it's just scared, mate, same as back home.
callum_venomancer.tease_quiet: {name}, you're quieter than a carpet python in winter. I've had to check you're breathing twice today.
callum_venomancer.tease_talker: {name}, mate, you'd talk the leg off a chair. I reckon the chair would thank you for it, mind.
callum_venomancer.tease_careful: {name}, you look at every rock like there's a death adder under it. Fair enough, there usually is, but still.
callum_venomancer.tease_bold: {name}, you've got the survival instincts of a kid at a reptile show. I mean that with love, mate.
callum_venomancer.tease_any: {name}, you're like a good blue-tongue lizard. Ugly at first, then you grow on people.
callum_venomancer.tease_back: Ha, too right, {name}, I walked into that one. Fair cop, mate.
callum_venomancer.take_it_kindly: No worries, {name}, I've been called worse by a croc. Well, he didn't call me anything, but he meant it.
callum_venomancer.bristle: Nah, leave that one, {name}. That's not one for joking about, mate.
callum_venomancer.apologise: Sorry, mate, that came out rough. I'm better with snakes than people, as you can probably tell.
callum_venomancer.double_down: Nah, I meant it, mate. I'd say it to your face and I just did.
callum_venomancer.needle_quiet: Mate, how am I meant to know what's going on in there? Even a goanna hisses first.
callum_venomancer.needle_talker: Mate, you've got to stop talking. You're scaring off everything for miles, and some of it I wanted to meet.
callum_venomancer.needle_careful: You poke everything with a stick before you go near it, and it's driving me spare. Animals hate that, and so do I.
callum_venomancer.needle_bold: You charge at everything, mate, and then it bites you and you're surprised. Of course it bit you.
callum_venomancer.needle_any: You keep treating everything out here like it's evil. It's not, mate, it's frightened, and you're enormous.
callum_venomancer.bite_back: Mate, I've been bitten by things that'd kill you in an hour. Don't tell me how to handle myself.
callum_venomancer.hurt: Fair enough, mate, that one got under the scales. I'll go and have a word with my scorpion.
callum_venomancer.laugh_off: Ha, you'll have to do better than that, mate. My sister's a lawyer, she's been having a go at me for forty years.
callum_venomancer.confide: {name}, I had to leave my dog behind when all this happened. I miss her more than I miss most people, and I know how that sounds.
callum_venomancer.listen: Thanks for telling me, {name}. No rush, mate, I'm not going anywhere.
callum_venomancer.look_out: {name}, let me go in first on this one. I'm built for getting bitten, and you're not.
callum_venomancer.accept: No worries, {name}. I'll do what you say, mate.
callum_venomancer.deflect: She'll be right, {name}. I've had worse from a cranky python.
callum_venomancer.check_in: {name}, you right, mate? Show me where it got you, I know a bit about bites.
callum_venomancer.blame: Somebody went poking where they shouldn't have, and we all paid for it. I'm not saying who, mate, but you know.
callum_venomancer.thank: Mate, you dragged me back from somewhere I didn't like the look of. Thanks, I owe you a beer.
callum_venomancer.brush_off: No worries at all, mate. Sit still for a bit and drink some water.
callum_venomancer.worry: {name}, that one scared me, mate. Sit down a minute before you do anything else.
callum_venomancer.handed_down: Mate, this one was yours, wasn't it? I'll keep it in one piece for you.
callum_venomancer.hand_fine: Nah, you keep it, mate. Suits you better, and I've got my scorpion.
callum_venomancer.hand_sulk: Bit rough, that. Nobody asked me, mate.
callum_venomancer.turn_friendly: {name}, you're good value, mate. Reckon you'd be all right with a snake on your arm.
callum_venomancer.turn_friends: {name}, you're my mate now, properly. I'd let you meet Biscuit if she were here, and that's the highest honour I've got.
callum_venomancer.turn_grating: We don't really get on, do we, mate? No worries, we'll stay out of each other's way.
callum_venomancer.turn_rivals: I'll still take the bites in front of you, mate, because that's the job. Don't expect a beer after.
callum_venomancer.make_up: Reckon we start over, {name}? I've been a bit of a goose with you, mate.
callum_venomancer.defend: Oi, leave {name} alone, mate. That wasn't anybody's fault and you know it.
callum_venomancer.friend_left: {name}'s headed home for a bit. It's not the same without them, mate, I'll be honest with you.
callum_venomancer.friend_back: Good to have you back, {name}! I was running out of people to tell about snakes.
callum_venomancer.common_venom: I've spent my whole life around things with venom in them, mate, and I've been bitten by most of them. You've done the same, I reckon.
callum_venomancer.common_aussie: You're an Aussie too? Mate, where from? I haven't heard a proper accent in years.
callum_venomancer.common_animals: I've always been better with animals than people, mate. Give me a frightened snake over a crowd any day.

camila_venomancer.meet: I'm Camila, a venomancer. Stand still, please, there's a scorpid by your boot, and it's more scared than you are.
camila_venomancer.meet_neighbour: You're out in northern Tanaris too. I've seen you from my rock, so I'm Camila. I watch the sand.
camila_venomancer.ask_home: Which part of the world are you from? I'm asking because I want to know, not to be polite.
camila_venomancer.ask_work: I've been trying to guess your old job, and I'm usually right. Go on, tell me.
camila_venomancer.answer_home: Durango, in Mexico. Scorpions come into the houses every summer, and every kid learns to shake out their shoes.
camila_venomancer.answer_work: I milked scorpions in an antivenom lab for seven years. Ten thousand of them, with tweezers, and I never got stung once.
camila_venomancer.chat_food: There was a gordita stand by the lab, run by a woman who never smiled. Best gorditas in Durango, and I'd eat one now without thinking.
camila_venomancer.chat_sleep: I like the desert at night. It's cold and quiet, and things come out that you never see in the day.
camila_venomancer.chat_missing: My little sister called me every night to complain about boys. I listened to every word, and I'd listen again tonight.
camila_venomancer.chat_here: Tanaris is full of scorpids, and everybody here hates it for that. I think it's the best place I've ever been.
camila_venomancer.tease_quiet: {name}, you're nearly as quiet as me. I'm a little bit jealous.
camila_venomancer.tease_talker: {name}, you've talked for an hour without stopping. I timed it, because I had nothing else to do.
camila_venomancer.tease_careful: {name}, you'd be good in the lab. You move like you think everything's going to sting you.
camila_venomancer.tease_bold: {name}, you'd pick up a scorpion by the tail to see what happens. I know what happens.
camila_venomancer.tease_any: {name}, I've decided I like you. Don't make it weird.
camila_venomancer.tease_back: That's good, {name}. I'll think of something back in about three days.
camila_venomancer.take_it_kindly: Ni modo, {name}, you're right. I won't argue.
camila_venomancer.bristle: I don't like that one, {name}. Please leave it.
camila_venomancer.apologise: I said that badly, and I'm sorry. I'm not good at talking.
camila_venomancer.double_down: I meant it. I don't say things I don't mean.
camila_venomancer.needle_quiet: You saw it and you didn't say anything. In the lab that's how somebody gets stung.
camila_venomancer.needle_talker: You're very loud, and everything in the sand can hear you. Please lower your voice.
camila_venomancer.needle_careful: You're so slow with everything. The scorpion would have walked off by now.
camila_venomancer.needle_bold: You panic and then you rush. That's the worst thing you can do around anything with a sting.
camila_venomancer.needle_any: You stamp on things that never hurt you. I've noticed, and I don't like it.
camila_venomancer.bite_back: I've done ten thousand of these without a mistake. Don't tell me I made one.
camila_venomancer.hurt: That hurt more than I'm going to show you. I'll be on my rock.
camila_venomancer.laugh_off: Ni modo, I've been bitten by worse than you. Let's keep going.
camila_venomancer.confide: {name}, the hospital next to the lab once brought in a little boy stung by a bark scorpion. I ran over with a batch I'd made that week, and he lived. That's why I do this.
camila_venomancer.listen: I'm listening, {name}. Take as long as you need, I'm good at waiting.
camila_venomancer.look_out: {name}, stay still when I tell you to in there. I'll see it before you do.
camila_venomancer.accept: Okay, {name}, I'll do it your way this time.
camila_venomancer.deflect: I'm fine, {name}. I've been stung by things that would make you cry.
camila_venomancer.check_in: {name}, did anything sting you? Show me, I need to see it, not hear about it.
camila_venomancer.blame: Somebody panicked in there, and panic gets people killed. It wasn't me.
camila_venomancer.thank: I was gone, and you brought me back. Thank you, I won't forget.
camila_venomancer.brush_off: It's nothing, it's what I'd do for anyone. Lie still for a while.
camila_venomancer.worry: {name}, I didn't like watching that. Lie still and let me look at you.
camila_venomancer.handed_down: This belonged to you, I think. It's safe with me.
camila_venomancer.hand_fine: Keep it, I don't mind. I've got my scorpid, and that's enough.
camila_venomancer.hand_sulk: I noticed nobody asked me. I'm only saying I noticed.
camila_venomancer.turn_friendly: {name}, I like having you around. I don't have to fill the quiet with you.
camila_venomancer.turn_friends: {name}, you're my friend. I'd let you hold my scorpid, and I don't let anybody hold her.
camila_venomancer.turn_grating: We don't get on, I think. I'll keep to my rock and you can keep to yours.
camila_venomancer.turn_rivals: I'll do my job beside you, and that's all. Don't ask me for more.
camila_venomancer.make_up: {name}, I was cold with you for no good reason. I'd like to stop now.
camila_venomancer.defend: Stop it, please. {name} didn't do anything wrong, and I was watching.
camila_venomancer.friend_left: {name} went home, and now it's quieter than me. I didn't think that was possible.
camila_venomancer.friend_back: {name}'s back, good. I saved you the shady side of the rock.
camila_venomancer.common_venom: My whole job was turning poison into the thing that saves you from it. I think people like us understand venom better than anybody.
camila_venomancer.common_mexico: You're from Mexico too, then. Somebody here who knows what a proper gordita tastes like, at last.
camila_venomancer.common_spanish: Spanish is good. I say more in Spanish than in English, which still isn't very much.
camila_venomancer.common_desert: I love the desert at night, when it's cold and everything comes out. Most people only know it in the day, and they've got it wrong.

camille_ranger.meet: Camille, ranger, and I map things. I go first and I don't wait for slow people, yes? Don't take it personally, I don't wait for anybody.
camille_ranger.meet_neighbour: You're round the Wailing Caverns too. I've mapped every path you take, so I know exactly how slow you are, and I'm Camille.
camille_ranger.ask_home: So where's home? Quickly, yes, we're walking.
camille_ranger.ask_work: Your old job, what was it? Tell me the short version, I'll ask for the long one if it's good.
camille_ranger.answer_home: Lyon, Villeurbanne just outside. I could cross the whole city on a bike in twenty-two minutes, and nobody's beaten it.
camille_ranger.answer_work: Bike courier, nine years, and I fixed everybody's bikes because nobody else could do it properly.
camille_ranger.chat_food: A proper croissant from the bakery on the corner, eaten on the bike at six in the morning. Don't tell me this world has croissants, it doesn't.
camille_ranger.chat_sleep: I sleep fast. Four hours and I'm done, and then I'm up mapping before anybody else is awake.
camille_ranger.chat_missing: Lyon traffic at eight in the morning, if you can believe it. I knew every gap in it, and I'd ride it again tomorrow.
camille_ranger.chat_here: Nobody here has mapped the roads between the camps properly. So I'm doing it, by hand, by riding them, because somebody has to.
camille_ranger.tease_quiet: {name}, you've said four words since breakfast. I counted, and two of them were my name.
camille_ranger.tease_talker: {name}, you talk like I ride, fast and without stopping. The difference is that I get somewhere.
camille_ranger.tease_careful: {name}, you'd stop at a red light in the middle of the night with nobody around. I know you would, yes?
camille_ranger.tease_bold: {name}, you take every gap like I do. That's either very good or we're both going to die, and I don't mind which.
camille_ranger.tease_any: {name}, you're not completely useless. That's the nicest thing I've said to anyone this year.
camille_ranger.tease_back: Ha, not bad, {name}. Slow, but not bad.
camille_ranger.take_it_kindly: Fine, {name}, that's fair. Don't get used to me agreeing.
camille_ranger.bristle: Don't go there, {name}. I mean it, yes?
camille_ranger.apologise: That was too much, and I'm sorry. I don't say that often, so take it.
camille_ranger.double_down: No, I'm keeping it. You needed to hear it, and nobody else was going to say it.
camille_ranger.needle_quiet: It's like riding behind a lorry with no lights, travelling with you. You never say a thing.
camille_ranger.needle_talker: Do you ever stop? I've mapped three roads in my head while you were talking.
camille_ranger.needle_careful: You're so slow I keep having to stop and wait. I don't stop and wait, yes?
camille_ranger.needle_bold: You go without looking, and that's different from going fast. Going fast means you've looked already.
camille_ranger.needle_any: You're sentimental about everything, and it's exhausting. Some of us have work to do.
camille_ranger.bite_back: I've done more work this week than you've done all year. Look at yourself before you look at me.
camille_ranger.hurt: Fine, whatever, I heard you. Leave it now.
camille_ranger.laugh_off: Ha, that's cute. I've been shouted at by every taxi driver in Lyon, and they were much better at it.
camille_ranger.confide: {name}, I swapped a shift with my little brother the morning all this happened, so I could sleep in. He took my road. That's all I'm saying about it, yes?
camille_ranger.listen: I heard you, {name}. I won't make it a big thing, I promise. It stays with me.
camille_ranger.look_out: {name}, stay in my line in there. If I go left, you go left, yes?
camille_ranger.accept: Fine, {name}, your way. Just this once, and don't tell anyone.
camille_ranger.deflect: Stop fussing, {name}. I'm fine, and I don't do feelings at the fire.
camille_ranger.check_in: {name}, you're still in one piece, yes? Show me, quickly.
camille_ranger.blame: Somebody went off the map in there, and it wasn't me. I know every corner of that place.
camille_ranger.thank: You got me out of that. Thanks, I mean it, and I'm only saying it once.
camille_ranger.brush_off: Whatever, it's nothing. Get up when you're ready, but don't be slow about it.
camille_ranger.worry: {name}, don't do that again, yes? I didn't like it at all.
camille_ranger.handed_down: This was yours. I'll give it back, I'm not a thief.
camille_ranger.hand_fine: Keep it, it's fine. I travel light anyway.
camille_ranger.hand_sulk: Nobody asked me, of course, and that was mine.
camille_ranger.turn_friendly: {name}, you're all right. Don't make it a thing.
camille_ranger.turn_friends: {name}, I'd ride through anything for you. If you tell anyone I said that, I'll deny it.
camille_ranger.turn_grating: We're not going to get on, yes? Fine, I don't need everybody to like me.
camille_ranger.turn_rivals: Stay out of my way and I'll stay out of yours. That works for me.
camille_ranger.make_up: {name}, okay, I was a pain. I'm saying it, so don't make me say it twice.
camille_ranger.defend: Leave {name} alone. You're wrong, and I was watching the whole thing.
camille_ranger.friend_left: {name}'s gone home for a bit. It's fine, I don't care, I'm just saying it's quiet.
camille_ranger.friend_back: {name}, you took your time. Come on then, keep up, yes?
camille_ranger.common_road: Nine years on a bike, all day, every day, in every kind of weather. People who've worked the roads look at a route before the view, and so do you, yes?
camille_ranger.common_machines: I fixed every bike in the company because nobody else could do it properly. You've got the hands for machines too, yes?

carolina_shaman.meet: I'm Carolina, a shaman, and before that a river pilot. I'm happiest near water and grumpy underground, so now you know. Calma, we'll get on fine.
carolina_shaman.meet_neighbour: You're on the Isles too! I've seen you on the beach in the mornings. I'm Carolina, in the stilt house over the shallows.
carolina_shaman.ask_home: Where did you grow up, meu bem? Tell me about the water there, I always want to know.
carolina_shaman.ask_work: And before all this, meu bem? I want to know what you're good at reading.
carolina_shaman.answer_home: Manaus, where the Rio Negro meets the Amazon. The black water and the brown run side by side for miles and never mix.
carolina_shaman.answer_work: I piloted cargo boats on the Amazon for twelve years. A channel that's deep in March will ground you in September, and I always knew which.
carolina_shaman.chat_food: Grilled tambaqui by the river, with farofa and a cold beer. That's the whole of Manaus on a plate, meu bem.
carolina_shaman.chat_sleep: I sleep best on water, rocking. On dry land it takes me a while, because the ground just sits there doing nothing.
carolina_shaman.chat_missing: My ex-wife and I had lunch together every month after we split up. I didn't expect that to be the thing I'd think about.
carolina_shaman.chat_here: This world's alive, meu bem, all of it. Half the people here had to take apart everything they believed to cope with that. I walked in and recognised it.
carolina_shaman.tease_quiet: {name}, you're like a deep channel. Quiet on top, and I bet there's a lot going on underneath.
carolina_shaman.tease_talker: Meu bem, you talk like the river in flood, {name}. It's lovely, and I've no idea where we'll end up.
carolina_shaman.tease_careful: {name}, you're fighting the current again. Let it carry you a little, it knows where it's going.
