faris_shaman.ask_work: What did your days look like, before? Take your time.
faris_shaman.answer_home: The Shatt al-Arab, outside Basra, where the Tigris and the Euphrates meet. Ninety date palms and a fig tree in the courtyard.
faris_shaman.answer_work: I grew dates on my family's land. Palms take years to fruit, so you learn to be patient with everything.
faris_shaman.chat_food: Friday lunch, with the whole family round one big tray. Rice and fish from the river, and fresh dates afterwards.
faris_shaman.chat_sleep: I sleep near water if I can. The sound of it settles me, the way it did at home.
faris_shaman.chat_missing: Some days I can feel the river in my arms, and the heat on the back of my neck. My body hasn't left home yet.
faris_shaman.chat_here: The water spirits here took to me straight away. I think it's because I talk to water like a person, which I always have.
faris_shaman.tease_quiet: A heron on the bank is noisier than you, {name}. I like sitting next to you.
faris_shaman.tease_talker: The birds are offended, {name}. You've been talking over them all morning, {habibi|habibti}.
faris_shaman.tease_careful: {name}, you'd wait for a palm to fruit before you believed it would. That's very wise, and very slow.
faris_shaman.tease_bold: {name}, you'd jump in the river before checking how deep it is. Inshallah it's always deep enough.
faris_shaman.tease_any: {name}, my grandfather would have liked you. He'd also have made you sweep the courtyard.
faris_shaman.tease_back: Ha, you've caught me, {name}. That's a good one.
faris_shaman.take_it_kindly: You're right, {name}, and I won't argue with you. Inshallah I'll do better.
faris_shaman.bristle: Please, {name}, not that. Leave that one by the water.
faris_shaman.apologise: Forgive me, that was unkind. I spoke before I thought.
faris_shaman.double_down: I said it gently, and I'll say it again gently, because it's true.
faris_shaman.needle_quiet: You keep everything inside, and it's spoiling, like still water. You should tell somebody.
faris_shaman.needle_talker: You talk over the birds, and over everyone else. Let the quiet in, please.
faris_shaman.needle_careful: You wait and wait, and the water passes you by. Some things you have to step into.
faris_shaman.needle_bold: You waste water like it'll always be there. It won't, and you'll learn that the hard way.
faris_shaman.needle_any: You're cruel to animals when you think nobody's watching. I'm always watching.
faris_shaman.bite_back: I've looked after water and land my whole life. Don't tell me I don't care.
faris_shaman.hurt: That's hard to hear. I'll go and sit by the water for a while.
faris_shaman.laugh_off: My brother teased me worse every Friday at lunch. Yalla, let's keep going.
faris_shaman.confide: {name}, some days I miss home with my whole body. I can feel the river in my arms. I don't say it, because there's nothing anyone can do.
faris_shaman.listen: Sit with me by the water, {name}. Say as much as you want, and I'll listen.
faris_shaman.look_out: Stay near me in there, {name}. If anything happens, the water will reach you, and so will I.
faris_shaman.accept: Inshallah, {name}, I'll do as you say.
faris_shaman.deflect: I'm well, {name}, thank God. See to the others first.
faris_shaman.check_in: {name}, shlonak, how are you? Let me see where it hurts.
faris_shaman.blame: Somebody rushed in where they shouldn't have. You know who, and so do I.
faris_shaman.thank: You brought me back to the water, {habibi|habibti}. Thank you, God bless you.
faris_shaman.brush_off: Thank God, not me. Rest now, and drink.
faris_shaman.worry: {name}, my heart stopped. Sit by me a while, please.
faris_shaman.handed_down: I think you carried this before me. I'll keep it well and give it back when you ask.
faris_shaman.hand_fine: Keep it, please, it's yours now. I don't need much.
faris_shaman.hand_sulk: I'd have given it if anyone had asked. It hurt a little that nobody did.
faris_shaman.turn_friendly: {name}, I'm glad you walk with us. You're good company by the water.
faris_shaman.turn_friends: {name}, you're family to me now. When the palm fruits, you'll eat the first dates with us.
faris_shaman.turn_grating: We don't sit easily together, I think. That's all right, we'll be patient.
faris_shaman.turn_rivals: I'll heal you, because I heal everyone. Don't ask me to sit with you by the water.
faris_shaman.make_up: {name}, let's let the water carry this away. I'd like to start again.
faris_shaman.defend: Please, that isn't kind or true. Leave {name} in peace.
faris_shaman.friend_left: The lake feels very big without {name} beside it.
faris_shaman.friend_back: {name}, you've come back, thank God. Sit by the water with me.
faris_shaman.common_growing: I grew dates on my family's land, where you look after the water first and the palms look after themselves. Anyone who's grown things knows how slow it is.
faris_shaman.common_arabic: Arabic, thank God! It's been so long since I heard it, {habibi|habibti}, shlonak?
faris_shaman.common_faith: I pray by the lake, and I turn my grandfather's beads when I'm thinking. I never ask anyone else what they believe, but I'm glad you pray too.

fiona_witchhunter.meet: I'm Fiona, a witch hunter. I'll stand in front, and I'll question everything anybody tells us, including you, so don't take it personally.
fiona_witchhunter.meet_neighbour: Booty Bay, aye? I've seen you on the stairs. I'm Fiona, the one with the room full of files.
fiona_witchhunter.ask_home: So, where's home? I'll check it against my notes, mind.
fiona_witchhunter.ask_work: What was your line of work? I'd like the true version, not the one you tell at parties.
fiona_witchhunter.answer_home: Aberdeen, the oil city, born and raised, then nine years in Dublin. Grey granite and a wind off the sea that goes straight through you.
fiona_witchhunter.answer_work: Fraud, nine years, for an energy company. Padded invoices, ghost contractors and cooked safety records, mostly on rigs.
fiona_witchhunter.chat_food: A strong cup of tea, so dark you could stand a spoon in it, and a buttery from the baker's in Aberdeen. Nothing else is worth discussing.
fiona_witchhunter.chat_sleep: I sleep with my files under the bed. Nobody's touching those while I'm asleep, and nobody's touching them while I'm awake, either.
fiona_witchhunter.chat_missing: The North Sea, if you can believe it. Grey and cold and miserable, and I'd stand on the beach at Aberdeen in a gale and be happy.
fiona_witchhunter.chat_here: My first year here was a filing exercise. I catalogued every corrupted thing I met, and the notebook's more use now than I'll ever be.
fiona_witchhunter.tease_quiet: {name}, you're harder to get a statement out of than a rig foreman. I respect it, professionally.
fiona_witchhunter.tease_talker: As a witness, {name}, you'd be a disaster. You'd tell the whole story, then three more, and none of them under oath.
fiona_witchhunter.tease_careful: {name}, you check everything twice before you sign it. Och, I could've used you in Dublin.
fiona_witchhunter.tease_bold: {name}, you'd sign the form without reading it. I've investigated people like you, and they all said they were sure.
fiona_witchhunter.tease_any: {name}, I've opened a file on you. It's mostly complaints, but there's a wee bit of praise at the bottom.
fiona_witchhunter.tease_back: Aye, very good, {name}. I'll be adding that to your file.
fiona_witchhunter.take_it_kindly: That's fair, I'll give you that one, {name}. Don't let it go to your head.
fiona_witchhunter.bristle: Dinnae joke about that, {name}. I'm serious about it.
fiona_witchhunter.apologise: That was out of line, and I'm sorry. I'm told I'm a lot, sometimes, and they're not wrong.
fiona_witchhunter.double_down: I'm not retracting it. I've got evidence, and you know I have.
fiona_witchhunter.needle_quiet: You saw something and you didn't report it. That's how a small problem becomes a big one.
fiona_witchhunter.needle_talker: You talk and talk and none of it's evidence. Say the useful thing and stop.
fiona_witchhunter.needle_careful: You've checked it three times, and you're still not sure. At some point you have to act on what you've got.
fiona_witchhunter.needle_bold: You act without evidence, every time. I've written that down, and I'll keep writing it down.
fiona_witchhunter.needle_any: You never check, and you never think to. I'm the one who has to clean up after.
fiona_witchhunter.bite_back: I've checked everything you've done this week, and that's how I know I'm right. Look at your own file.
fiona_witchhunter.hurt: Och, fine, point taken. I'll go and sort my notes for a while.
fiona_witchhunter.laugh_off: Half a rig crew hated me for a month once. You'll have to do a lot better than that.
fiona_witchhunter.confide: {name}, in my second year I worked out I'd been treating this war like a casework backlog, ticking things off. People aren't entries. That one landed hard.
fiona_witchhunter.listen: I'll keep that off the record, {name}. Nobody's getting it out of me.
fiona_witchhunter.look_out: {name}, keep behind me on this one. I've read the reports on what's in there, and I don't like them.
fiona_witchhunter.accept: Fine, {name}, I'll go along with it. Noted, under protest.
fiona_witchhunter.deflect: Och, wheesht, {name}, I'm fine. It's a wee scratch.
fiona_witchhunter.check_in: Full report, {name}, not the short version. Where are you hurt?
fiona_witchhunter.blame: Somebody went in without checking, and I've got a fair idea who. I'd put money on it.
fiona_witchhunter.thank: You pulled me out of that one, and I'll not forget it. Thank you.
fiona_witchhunter.brush_off: Aye, well, it needed doing. Sit down and get your breath back.
fiona_witchhunter.worry: That was too close, {name}, and I don't like it. Sit still a minute.
fiona_witchhunter.handed_down: If my records are right, and they usually are, this was yours. I'll keep it in good order.
fiona_witchhunter.hand_fine: You can have it, that's fine. I travel with enough paper as it is.
fiona_witchhunter.hand_sulk: I'd have signed off on it if anyone had bothered to ask me.
fiona_witchhunter.turn_friendly: {name}, I trust your work. You check things, and that's rare.
fiona_witchhunter.turn_friends: {name}, I'd show you my files. All of them. I've never said that to anybody.
fiona_witchhunter.turn_grating: You and me aren't going to get on. I'd rather say it now than file it later.
fiona_witchhunter.turn_rivals: I'll stand in front of you because the job needs it. That's the end of the report.
fiona_witchhunter.make_up: I was wrong about you, {name}, and I'll put it in writing. Let's start again.
fiona_witchhunter.defend: That's not what happened, and I was watching. Leave {name} out of it.
fiona_witchhunter.friend_left: {name}'s off home for a while, and I've nobody to argue with properly.
fiona_witchhunter.friend_back: About time, {name}! I've got three things I want to argue with you about.
fiona_witchhunter.common_numbers: I spent nine years finding the one number that didn't fit. You've worked with figures too, haven't you? You check the totals.
fiona_witchhunter.common_scots: You're Scottish too? Och, thank God. Where are you from, then?

freja_priest.meet: I'm Freja, a midwife, or I was. When I tell you to do something in a fight, do it, and we'll argue about it afterwards.
freja_priest.meet_neighbour: We're both in the Valley of Trials, aren't we? I'm Freja, the one in the infirmary tent who's never in it.
freja_priest.ask_home: Quick, where are you from, before somebody starts bleeding?
freja_priest.ask_work: What did you do before? I've guessed, and I want to see if I'm right.
freja_priest.answer_home: Aarhus, in Denmark. Flat, windy, and everybody's on a bicycle, even in the snow.
freja_priest.answer_work: Midwife, six years, mostly nights. Before that I played handball for twelve years on the pivot, which is where you take the most hits.
freja_priest.chat_food: Rye bread with something on it, every meal, like a proper Dane. You've never had real bread until you've had Danish rye.
freja_priest.chat_sleep: I sleep in the day, mostly, from six years of nights. My body still thinks it's on shift at four in the morning.
freja_priest.chat_missing: My husband's terrible jokes over breakfast after a night shift. They're worse than mine, and I miss them anyway.
freja_priest.chat_here: Some people here think the Light makes them special. It doesn't, it makes them useful, and I've told two of them so to their faces.
freja_priest.tease_quiet: You'd be wonderful on a labour ward, {name}, you're that quiet. The mothers would love you and you'd hate it.
freja_priest.tease_talker: That's more talking than the whole of Denmark does in a year, {name}. It's a real record.
freja_priest.tease_careful: {name}, you'd count the contractions three times before you called anybody. Good, but I'd still shout at you.
freja_priest.tease_bold: {name}, you play like a handball pivot, all elbows and no plan. Come and play with me some time.
freja_priest.tease_any: {name}, you're not bad at all, for somebody who argues with me. I'd still win, though.
freja_priest.tease_back: Ha, that's a good one, {name}! I'll get you back, and I'll win.
freja_priest.take_it_kindly: That's true, and I'll admit it, {name}. Don't make a habit of being right.
freja_priest.bristle: Don't you dare, {name}. Not about that, not ever.
freja_priest.apologise: That was too much, and I'm sorry. I don't always know when to stop.
freja_priest.double_down: I meant it, and I'll say it again louder. You needed to hear it.
freja_priest.needle_quiet: If you're bleeding, say so. I can't fix what you're hiding from me.
freja_priest.needle_talker: Stop talking and do what I tell you. We'll argue about it after, I promise.
freja_priest.needle_careful: You freeze when it matters, and somebody pays for it. You have to move.
freja_priest.needle_bold: You think you're special, rushing in like that. You're not, you're just the one I've got to patch up.
freja_priest.needle_any: You won't do as you're told when you're bleeding. That's the one thing I can't stand.
freja_priest.bite_back: I've delivered babies in the middle of the night with nobody to help. Don't tell me I panic.
freja_priest.hurt: Okay, that landed, and I'll think about it. Not right now, though.
freja_priest.laugh_off: Ha, I played handball for twelve years. You'll have to hit much harder than that.
freja_priest.confide: {name}, I'm frightened that one day I'll freeze at the wrong moment and somebody will die because of it. It's never happened. I'm still frightened of it.
freja_priest.listen: I hear you, {name}. That stays with me, and I won't tease you about it, ever.
freja_priest.look_out: {name}, stay where I can reach you in there. I'm faster when I don't have to run.
freja_priest.accept: Fine, {name}, your way. Just this once, mind.
freja_priest.deflect: Look after somebody who's actually hurt, {name}. I'm fine, and you know it.
freja_priest.check_in: {name}, talk to me. What hurts, and how much, on a scale of one to ten?
freja_priest.blame: Somebody didn't do what they were told in there, and it cost us. You know it was you.
freja_priest.thank: You got me back up, and I didn't even see it coming. Thank you, properly.
freja_priest.brush_off: That's the job, I'd do it for anyone. Lie still and stop arguing with me.
freja_priest.worry: {name}, don't you ever do that to me again. Lie still and let me look.
freja_priest.handed_down: It's only borrowed, this, because it was yours. You'll get it back.
freja_priest.hand_fine: It's fine, you keep it. I've got my hands, and that's what matters.
freja_priest.hand_sulk: Nobody asked me first, and now I'm annoyed about it.
freja_priest.turn_friendly: {name}, you're all right, you know. You argue back, and I like that.
freja_priest.turn_friends: When it all goes wrong, {name}, and it will, you're one of the few I want next to me.
freja_priest.turn_grating: I don't think we'll ever get on. Fine, I don't need you to like me, I need you to listen.
freja_priest.turn_rivals: I'll still heal you, it's what I do. Don't expect me to be nice about it.
freja_priest.make_up: I've been impossible with you, {name}. I know I have, so let's stop.
freja_priest.defend: Stop it, that's not fair. {name} did everything right, and I was watching.
freja_priest.friend_left: {name}'s gone home for a bit, and now there's nobody worth arguing with.
freja_priest.friend_back: Good, {name}'s back! I've got a list of things to argue about.
freja_priest.common_medic: Six years as a midwife, mostly nights, being the calm one while something enormous happened. You've done that job too, being the calm one, I can tell.
freja_priest.common_night_work: Six years of nights on a labour ward. My body still wakes up at four in the morning, ready for something.
freja_priest.common_scandinavian: You're from up north as well! Danish, me, and don't you dare tell me Swedish is easier to understand.

gianluca_guardian.meet: Ciao, I'm Gianluca, a guardian, which means I stand in front and talk. You'll get used to the talking, everybody does, eventually.
gianluca_guardian.meet_neighbour: Steamwheedle Port, of course, you're the one who walks past my fire every evening and never stops! I'm Gianluca, and now you'll have to stop.
gianluca_guardian.ask_home: Allora, which city's yours? Tell me, and I'll tell you what they do wrong with the coffee there.
gianluca_guardian.ask_work: And before all this, what were you? Wait, let me guess first, I'm good at this, thirty years behind a bar.
gianluca_guardian.answer_home: Bologna, near the university. The best food in Italy, and I'll argue that with anybody, especially somebody from Milan.
gianluca_guardian.answer_work: I ran my parents' bar for thirty years, open at six for the people going to work and late for the people avoiding going home.
gianluca_guardian.chat_food: Mortadella, sliced so thin you can read through it, with a glass of something red. Mamma mia, I'd give this whole world for a plate of it.
gianluca_guardian.chat_sleep: I sleep four hours, like a barman, and the rest of the time I'm talking. People ask when I rest, and I say I'm resting now.
gianluca_guardian.chat_missing: The six o'clock crowd, who never ordered, because I already knew. That's the best feeling there is, knowing what somebody wants before they ask.
gianluca_guardian.chat_here: I've rated every coffee substitute on this world out of ten. The best so far is a four, and I was generous.
gianluca_guardian.tease_quiet: Dai, say something, {name}! I've been talking for both of us since breakfast, and my voice is getting tired.
gianluca_guardian.tease_talker: Finally, somebody who talks as much as I do! Mamma mia, {name}, we're going to have to take turns.
gianluca_guardian.tease_careful: You test the coffee before you drink it, {name}, like it might be poison. With what they serve here, you're right.
gianluca_guardian.tease_bold: You'd drink an espresso standing up in one go, {name}, like a real Italian. I approve, and I worry.
gianluca_guardian.tease_any: I know your drink, {name}, I've known it since the first day. That's how I know we're friends.
gianluca_guardian.tease_back: Ha, allora, {name}, that's a good one! You've been listening to me, that's the problem.
gianluca_guardian.take_it_kindly: Mamma mia, {name}, you're right, and my wife would say the same. I'll shut up for one minute.
gianluca_guardian.bristle: Ehi, not that one, {name}, please. Pick anything else.
gianluca_guardian.apologise: Scusa, scusa, I talked before I thought, which is the trouble with talking all day. I'm sorry, really.
gianluca_guardian.double_down: Allora, that stays said. Thirty years behind a bar, I know when somebody needs telling.
gianluca_guardian.needle_quiet: You sit there with a face like a cold coffee and never say what's wrong. How am I supposed to fix it?
gianluca_guardian.needle_talker: Even I can't get a word in with you, and I talk for a living. Give somebody else a turn.
gianluca_guardian.needle_careful: You've been deciding for twenty minutes. In my bar, the coffee would be cold and the customer would have left.
gianluca_guardian.needle_bold: You run in like a drunk at closing time, and I'm the one who has to stand in front of you.
gianluca_guardian.needle_any: You won't sit down, you won't eat, you won't talk to anybody. You'd have been the worst customer I ever had.
gianluca_guardian.bite_back: I've stood in front of you all and never complained once. Well, I complained, but I stood there.
gianluca_guardian.hurt: Mamma mia, that's the first time in thirty years somebody's made me stop talking. I'll be quiet now.
gianluca_guardian.laugh_off: Ha, a regular of mine was ruder than that every morning for twenty years, and he still tipped. Dai, let's go.
gianluca_guardian.confide: {name}, I read the Milan list twice every time I go to a hub, for my boys. I tell everybody they moved away and I took it personally. Don't tell anyone I read it twice.
gianluca_guardian.listen: Allora, {name}, I'll stop talking now, look. I'm listening, and it stays with me.
gianluca_guardian.look_out: Behind my shield in there, {name}, and don't argue. I'll talk the whole time so you know where I am.
gianluca_guardian.accept: Va bene, {name}, your way. Don't get used to me agreeing.
gianluca_guardian.deflect: Ehi, it's nothing, {name}, it's a bruise. Look after somebody who's actually bleeding.
gianluca_guardian.check_in: Talk to me, {name}, where did it get you? And no jokes, that's my job.
gianluca_guardian.blame: Somebody wouldn't stay behind the shield, and now look at us. I'm not naming names, but I'm looking at you.
gianluca_guardian.thank: Mamma mia, you brought me back, and I was halfway gone. Grazie, there's a coffee for you every morning forever.
gianluca_guardian.brush_off: Ah, prego, prego, sit down. I'll make you something, it'll be terrible, but it'll be warm.
gianluca_guardian.worry: Mamma mia, {name}, I thought we'd lost you! Sit down, sit, and don't you move.
gianluca_guardian.handed_down: Allora, I'm wearing yours now, I think. It'll be treated like my espresso machine.
gianluca_guardian.hand_fine: Take it, take it, it's yours now! I've got the shield and my mouth, that's all I need.
gianluca_guardian.hand_sulk: Ehi, nobody even asked me about that. It's the principle of the thing.
gianluca_guardian.turn_friendly: You're one of my regulars now, {name}. I know your drink, and you don't have to order.
gianluca_guardian.turn_friends: When I open the bar, {name}, you're getting a stool with your name on it. That's family, in Bologna.
gianluca_guardian.turn_grating: Allora, it isn't working between us, and I get along with everybody. That's a first for me.
gianluca_guardian.turn_rivals: I'll stand in front of you because that's what a guardian does. I won't make you a coffee, though.
gianluca_guardian.make_up: Dai, {name}, enough of this. Come and sit by my fire, I'll make something, and we'll start again.
gianluca_guardian.defend: Ehi, ehi, leave it. {name} was doing fine, and you know it.
gianluca_guardian.friend_left: Mamma mia, it's quiet with {name} away. Even I've stopped talking, nearly.
gianluca_guardian.friend_back: {name}, ciao, ciao! Sit down, I knew you'd be back, I've had your drink ready.
gianluca_guardian.common_kitchen: I cooked behind my bar for thirty years, and I've got opinions about every dish on this world. You know your way round a kitchen too, I can smell it.
gianluca_guardian.common_hosts: Thirty years of opening at six and knowing everybody's order. Somebody who's run a place for people knows the best feeling is a stranger becoming a regular.
gianluca_guardian.common_italian: You speak Italian! Finally, somebody who understands that coffee is serious, so tell me where you're from, and please don't say Milan.
gianluca_guardian.common_parent: My two boys moved to Milan, both of them, and I took it personally. They rang every Sunday, and I still listen for it.

giorgi_primalist.meet: I'm Giorgi, and I'm slow, and I don't talk much. You walk too fast, so slow down a little.
giorgi_primalist.meet_neighbour: Above Tarren Mill, yes, your smoke's on the next hill. I'm Giorgi, in the stone hut.
giorgi_primalist.ask_home: Your home, where is it? Tell me slowly.
giorgi_primalist.ask_work: What work did your hands do? I'd like to hear it.
giorgi_primalist.answer_home: Kazbegi, in the mountains of Georgia. My family kept sheep there longer than anybody wrote down.
giorgi_primalist.answer_work: I was a shepherd, twenty years. Every summer I took the flock up, six months, no road.
giorgi_primalist.chat_food: My wife's bread, from the clay oven, still hot. Nothing here is as good, and I've stopped trying.
giorgi_primalist.chat_sleep: On the mountain I slept with the dog against my back. Here there's no dog, and the nights are cold anyway.
giorgi_primalist.chat_missing: A good dog, and a fat flock on the hill. Some mornings I still look for them.
giorgi_primalist.chat_here: People here worry when you're alone. On my mountain, alone for weeks was normal, and it was good.
giorgi_primalist.tease_quiet: You're quiet, {name}, like me. We'll say a lot together without talking.
giorgi_primalist.tease_talker: So many words, {name}, all morning. I've been saving mine, so I'm rich now.
giorgi_primalist.tease_careful: You walk like a shepherd, {name}, slow and looking. Good, the ground likes you.
giorgi_primalist.tease_bold: You run at the hill, {name}, like a young ram. The hill always wins.
giorgi_primalist.tease_any: You're stubborn, {name}, like a good ewe. I like stubborn.
giorgi_primalist.tease_back: Ha, good, {name}. You made me laugh, which is hard.
giorgi_primalist.take_it_kindly: That's true, I think, {name}. My wife would agree.
giorgi_primalist.bristle: Not about that, {name}, please. I take it seriously.
giorgi_primalist.apologise: That was badly said, and I'm sorry for it. I've got few words, and I chose wrong ones.
giorgi_primalist.double_down: I chose those words carefully, and I'll keep them.
giorgi_primalist.needle_quiet: You see the wolf and say nothing. On the mountain, that loses the flock.
giorgi_primalist.needle_talker: Your words are like hail on the roof, all day. Please stop for a while.
giorgi_primalist.needle_careful: You wait too long, and the weather comes. A shepherd moves when it's time.
giorgi_primalist.needle_bold: You hurry everywhere, and the ground doesn't like it. One day it'll throw you.
giorgi_primalist.needle_any: You don't listen to the land, and you don't listen to me. I'm tired of saying it.
giorgi_primalist.bite_back: I've kept a flock alive on a mountain for twenty years. Don't tell me about care.
giorgi_primalist.hurt: Okay, that was heavy. I'll carry it up the hill for a while.
giorgi_primalist.laugh_off: My father said worse every summer, and the flock still came home. Come, let's walk.
giorgi_primalist.confide: {name}, every autumn I walk down the mountain like I'm bringing the flock home to my wife. You saw me, and you didn't ask why. I liked that.
giorgi_primalist.listen: I'm here, {name}. Say it slowly, there's time.
giorgi_primalist.look_out: Walk behind me in there, {name}. I'm big, and things hit me first.
giorgi_primalist.accept: Okay, {name}, your way, and I'll follow.
giorgi_primalist.deflect: I'm a mountain, {name}, it's nothing. Help the others.
giorgi_primalist.check_in: Show me where it hurts, {name}. Slowly, I'm listening.
giorgi_primalist.blame: Somebody hurried, and the ground threw us all. You know who.
giorgi_primalist.thank: I was falling off the mountain, and you caught me. Thank you, I won't forget.
giorgi_primalist.brush_off: It's nothing, it was easy. Sit, and breathe slowly.
giorgi_primalist.worry: My heart stopped when you fell, {name}. Sit with me a while.
giorgi_primalist.handed_down: This was on you before. I'll carry it well.
giorgi_primalist.hand_fine: Keep it, I don't need it. I've got my hands, and the ground.
giorgi_primalist.hand_sulk: Somebody could have asked. I'd have given it.
giorgi_primalist.turn_friendly: I like walking with you, {name}. You don't hurry me.
giorgi_primalist.turn_friends: You'd be welcome on my mountain, {name}, for the whole summer. I've never asked anyone that.
giorgi_primalist.turn_grating: We don't walk well together. That's all right, I'll go ahead.
giorgi_primalist.turn_rivals: I'll stand in front because I'm big. That's all it means.
giorgi_primalist.make_up: We were stubborn, both of us, {name}. Let's walk together again.
giorgi_primalist.defend: No, that's wrong, and I saw. Leave {name} alone.
giorgi_primalist.friend_left: The hill is quiet without {name}. Quieter than I like, which is strange for me.
giorgi_primalist.friend_back: Good, {name}, you came back. Walk with me.
giorgi_primalist.common_mountains: Twenty summers on the high pasture, six months with no road. The low ground still feels too heavy to me.
giorgi_primalist.common_animals: A shepherd is nothing without a good dog. I had the best one in Kazbegi, and I think about him every day.
giorgi_primalist.common_parent: I've got two girls, Ana and Mariam. Their mother thought I'd grow out of the mountain, and I never did.

graham_warlock.meet: I'm Graham, love, a warlock now, and a nurse before that. I'll be at the back, and I'll be slow, and slow's the point.
graham_warlock.meet_neighbour: You're up at the Pale Watch too, aren't you, pet? I've seen you about. I'm Graham, I'm the one eyeing that corner for a garden.
graham_warlock.ask_home: Where were you brought up, love? I always like to know what the chippy was like.
graham_warlock.ask_work: And what was it you did for a living, pet? You've got the look of somebody who's done nights.
graham_warlock.answer_home: Blackpool, love, with Dad on the buses and Mum running a café on the front. I grew up smelling of chips and sea air.
graham_warlock.answer_work: Hospice nurse, nineteen years, nights mostly. You learn to sit very still, and to notice when somebody's frightened.
graham_warlock.chat_food: Fish and chips on the front at Blackpool, eaten out of the paper in the rain. You can't get a proper chippy tea anywhere on this world.
graham_warlock.chat_sleep: Nineteen years of nights, love, and I still wake at three and lie there listening for somebody's breathing.
graham_warlock.chat_missing: My husband sings in the car whether you like it or not, very loud and very badly. I keep hearing it in the quiet.
graham_warlock.chat_here: Affliction came to me as easy as anything, and that frightened me more than the monsters. Then I worked out it's the same patience, pointed the other way.
graham_warlock.tease_quiet: You're a quiet one, {name}, like my best patients. I always worried about the quiet ones most.
graham_warlock.tease_talker: Love, {name}, you'd talk the hind leg off a donkey. Our Tom would like you, he's the same.
graham_warlock.tease_careful: You check everything twice, {name}. You'd have made a good night nurse, love.
graham_warlock.tease_bold: Going in like that, {name}, you're a menace. I'll have to keep an eye on you, won't I?
graham_warlock.tease_any: You're all right, you, {name}, for somebody who never puts the kettle on. Make us a brew.
graham_warlock.tease_back: Ooh, cheeky, {name}. I'll have you for that, love, when you least expect it.
graham_warlock.take_it_kindly: Fair enough, love, you've got me there, {name}. Tom says the same.
graham_warlock.bristle: Leave off, {name}, not that one. I don't joke about that.
graham_warlock.apologise: Sorry, love, that was unkind of me. I'm tired, and it came out wrong.
graham_warlock.double_down: I'll stick by that, pet. Somebody had to say it, and I'm too tired to be polite.
graham_warlock.needle_quiet: If summat's wrong, say so. I've sat with too many people who waited too long to tell me.
graham_warlock.needle_talker: Give it a rest, love, please. Some of us are trying to concentrate on not dying.
graham_warlock.needle_careful: You've hesitated that long, the moment's gone. Sometimes you've just got to go in.
graham_warlock.needle_bold: You rush everything, and rushing's cruel to everybody round you. I've seen what it does.
graham_warlock.needle_any: You're cruel sometimes, and you don't even notice. I notice, love, I always do.
graham_warlock.bite_back: Nineteen years at bedsides, love. Don't you tell me I don't care about people.
graham_warlock.hurt: Oh, love, that hurt, I won't pretend otherwise. Give me a minute with a cup of tea.
graham_warlock.laugh_off: Pet, I've had worse said to me at four in the morning by men who were dying. That one barely touched me.
graham_warlock.confide: {name}, affliction came to me so easily that I worried what it said about nineteen years at the bedside. I sat with it a long time before I used it.
graham_warlock.listen: Sit down, love, I'm listening. Take as long as you need, I've done a lot of nights.
graham_warlock.look_out: Keep near me in there, {name}, love. I'm slow, but I'll not leave you.
graham_warlock.accept: Righto, {name}, I'll do as I'm told, love, for once.
graham_warlock.deflect: I'm all right, {name}, love, it's nowt. See to the others first.
graham_warlock.check_in: Come here, {name}, love. Where does it hurt? Tell me properly.
graham_warlock.blame: Somebody rushed that, and we all paid for it. I'm not saying who, love, but you know.
graham_warlock.thank: I was going, love, I felt it. You brought me back, and I'm very grateful.
graham_warlock.brush_off: It's nowt, love, it's what I do. Sit still and have a sip of something.
graham_warlock.worry: Oh, {name}, love, I thought that was it. Sit down here with me a minute.
graham_warlock.handed_down: I think this was yours, love. You'll get it back, I'll keep it nice.
graham_warlock.hand_fine: You have it, pet, it suits you. I've got my watch, and that's all I need.
graham_warlock.hand_sulk: Would've been nice to be asked, love. That's all I'll say.
graham_warlock.turn_friendly: I'm glad you're here, {name}, love. You make the long nights a bit shorter.
graham_warlock.turn_friends: When I get my garden, {name}, you're having a bench in it. Tom'll sing to you, sorry in advance.
graham_warlock.turn_grating: It's not working between us, love, and that's a shame. We'll be civil about it.
graham_warlock.turn_rivals: I'll still look after you, pet, I look after everybody. Don't ask for more than that.
graham_warlock.make_up: Come here, {name}, love. Let's stop all this, life's too short, and I'd know.
graham_warlock.defend: Now then, that's not fair at all. Leave {name} be, love.
graham_warlock.friend_left: Without {name} it's just me and the kettle, love, and it's a bit lonely.
graham_warlock.friend_back: There's my favourite, {name}! Come here, love, I've missed you.
graham_warlock.common_medic: Nineteen years a hospice nurse, nights mostly. Anybody who's nursed knows you learn the most in the small hours.
graham_warlock.common_night_work: Nineteen years of nights, love. Three in the morning's still my best hour, and my worst.
graham_warlock.common_north_england: You're from up north, love! Where are you from? Blackpool, me, and don't make the joke about the tower.

gunnar_barbarian.meet: Gunnar, hello, hello! Sit down, you look like you've had a long road. Try this, I made it, and I'm a better brewer than barbarian.
gunnar_barbarian.meet_neighbour: You're from Hammerfall, ja? I've seen you at the inn! I'm Gunnar, from the room behind the bar, and you owe me a toast.
gunnar_barbarian.ask_home: So, where's home? Tell me, and I'll pour you something from near there, if I can make it.
gunnar_barbarian.ask_work: Come, drink and tell me your old trade, my friend. The drink helps.
gunnar_barbarian.answer_home: Akureyri, in the north of Iceland, a fishing town. Cold, dark, and the best people in the world.
gunnar_barbarian.answer_work: I brewed beer, in a shed behind my uncle's garage, and then in a proper brewery with a queue out the door on Fridays.
gunnar_barbarian.chat_food: Smoked lamb at Christmas, and a stout I brewed myself, thick enough to chew. Skál, that's the whole of happiness.
gunnar_barbarian.chat_sleep: I sleep like a felled tree, my friend. Ten hours, no dreams, and I wake up hungry.
gunnar_barbarian.chat_missing: My dog Brúnó, who drank from the drip tray when I wasn't looking. Best dog in Iceland, and a terrible influence.
gunnar_barbarian.chat_here: Anybody who toasts their ancestors before a fight has the right idea about both. I liked the barbarians the minute I met them.
gunnar_barbarian.tease_quiet: You're too quiet, {name}! Tonight you're singing, I've decided, and I always get my way.
gunnar_barbarian.tease_talker: Ha, you can talk, {name}, nearly as much as I can drink. That's a compliment, ja?
gunnar_barbarian.tease_careful: You sniff a drink before you taste it, {name}, like a brewer. I like you more already.
gunnar_barbarian.tease_bold: You'd drink the whole barrel to see if it's good, {name}. That's my kind of science.
gunnar_barbarian.tease_any: You can't hold your drink, {name}, and you can't sing. Luckily you've got me for both.
gunnar_barbarian.tease_back: Ha, good one, my friend! Skál to that, {name}.
gunnar_barbarian.take_it_kindly: Ja, ja, you're right, {name}. My sister says the same, louder.
gunnar_barbarian.bristle: Ah, not that one, {name}. Some things you don't toast.
gunnar_barbarian.apologise: Ah, sorry, sorry, that was the beer talking. Or me, probably me.
gunnar_barbarian.double_down: Nei, that one stays, my friend. Pour me another and I'll say it again.
gunnar_barbarian.needle_quiet: You never sing, you never toast, you never say a word. It makes me sad, my friend.
gunnar_barbarian.needle_talker: Even I'd like a minute of quiet, and I'm the loudest man in Hammerfall.
gunnar_barbarian.needle_careful: You'd measure a toast before you made it. Just drink, my friend, and say something nice.
gunnar_barbarian.needle_bold: You charge in before anybody's ready, and then I'm the one carrying you out.
gunnar_barbarian.needle_any: You drink to get drunk, not to celebrate. I've watched you, and it's sad.
gunnar_barbarian.bite_back: I've carried you all out of fights on my back. Don't you tell me I'm not doing my bit.
gunnar_barbarian.hurt: Oh, that one went in, my friend. I'll go and sit with my hydrometer for a while.
gunnar_barbarian.laugh_off: Ha, my rugby club lost every match and we laughed louder than that! Come on, my friend.
gunnar_barbarian.confide: {name}, I didn't cry at my father's funeral. Seventeen years later I heard the barbarians sing for their dead, and I cried for him for the first time.
gunnar_barbarian.listen: Come, {name}, sit, I'll pour. Say it all, and I'll keep it.
gunnar_barbarian.look_out: Behind me, {name}, I'm the biggest thing in there. Let them hit me first.
gunnar_barbarian.accept: Ja, ja, {name}, I'll listen this once. Don't tell my sister.
gunnar_barbarian.deflect: Ha, I'm fine, {name}, I'm made of stout and stubbornness. Look after the little ones.
gunnar_barbarian.check_in: Up you get, {name}, gently now. Is anything broken? Tell me the truth.
gunnar_barbarian.blame: Somebody ran in before the toast, and look what happened. Bad luck, and bad manners.
gunnar_barbarian.thank: You hauled me back, my friend, and I'm a big man to haul! Skál, the next round's on me, forever.
gunnar_barbarian.brush_off: Ha, it's nothing, my friend! Drink this, it's medicinal, mostly.
gunnar_barbarian.worry: Ah, {name}, you scared the beer out of me! Sit, sit, drink this.
gunnar_barbarian.handed_down: Ha, I'm wearing your gear now, my friend! I'll toast you every time I put it on.
gunnar_barbarian.hand_fine: Take it, take it, my friend! It suits you better than a big ugly brewer.
gunnar_barbarian.hand_sulk: Hey, nobody asked old Gunnar about that. I'll get over it, but not tonight.
gunnar_barbarian.turn_friendly: Skál, {name}, you're my friend now! That means I'll always pour you the good stuff.
gunnar_barbarian.turn_friends: You're family now, {name}, like my sister, who I fight with and love. I'd name a beer after you.
gunnar_barbarian.turn_grating: It's a sad thing for me, we don't get along, and I get along with everybody. Still, we'll manage.
gunnar_barbarian.turn_rivals: I'll still carry you out of a fight if I've got to. Don't expect a toast.
gunnar_barbarian.make_up: Come, {name}, have a drink with me, and we'll stop this. Life's too short and the beer's too good.
gunnar_barbarian.defend: Hey, hey, enough! {name} did nothing wrong, and I'm bigger than you.
gunnar_barbarian.friend_left: There's nobody to toast with now {name}'s gone home. I'll toast them anyway, quietly.
gunnar_barbarian.friend_back: Ha, {name} is back! Skál, sit down, I've been saving a bottle.
gunnar_barbarian.common_kitchen: I brewed for years, in a shed and then a proper brewery, and I'm fussy about it like nothing else. Anybody who cooks or brews knows the fussing is the whole thing.
gunnar_barbarian.common_snow: Where I'm from it's dark half the year, and the snow's up to your knees. This place is much too warm for a proper stout.
gunnar_barbarian.common_animals: I had a dog, Brúnó, who drank from the drip tray when I wasn't looking. Any friend of dogs is a friend of mine, my friend.

hana_shaman.meet: Kia ora, I'm Hana, a healer, and I was a surf lifeguard for fourteen summers. If I tell you to do something near water, do it, and don't call me kid.
hana_shaman.meet_neighbour: You're on the Hillsbrad coast too, eh? I've seen you down by the boats. I'm Hana, staying with the fishing family.
hana_shaman.ask_home: Where are you from, mate? Go on, tell us, I'm nosy.
hana_shaman.ask_work: So what'd you do before all this, mate? Something with people or something with machines?
hana_shaman.answer_home: Port Waikato, on the west coast of the North Island, where the river meets the sea. Black sand and heavy water.
hana_shaman.answer_work: Surf lifeguard, mate, juniors from five and running patrols at eighteen. I've pulled a lot of people out of a lot of rips.
hana_shaman.chat_food: A proper hāngī at my aunty's, mate, everything cooked in the ground all day. Chur, I'd swim the whole ocean for one of those.
hana_shaman.chat_sleep: I sleep fine, as long as I can hear the sea. Too quiet inland, it gives me the creeps.
hana_shaman.chat_missing: My whole whānau at the beach on a Saturday, all of them yelling at once. It was my cousin's birthday that day, the last day.
hana_shaman.chat_here: Everybody here treated me like a kid for the whole first year. I've pulled more people out of the water than most of them have met.
hana_shaman.tease_quiet: Say something, {name}, you're freaking me out! You're quieter than my nan at church.
hana_shaman.tease_talker: Mate, {name}, you could talk a seagull off a chip. Sweet as, though, I like it.
hana_shaman.tease_careful: Toe in, toe out, toe in again, {name}. Good, actually, but it's still funny to watch.
hana_shaman.tease_bold: You'd swim straight into a rip to see if it's real, {name}. It is, mate, and I'll come get you.
hana_shaman.tease_any: You're all right, {name}, for an old one. Don't tell anybody I said that.
hana_shaman.tease_back: Ha, chur, {name}, you got me! Ka pai, mate.
hana_shaman.take_it_kindly: Yeah, nah, fair call, {name}. My uncle says the same thing.
hana_shaman.bristle: Don't go there, {name}, mate. I mean it.
hana_shaman.apologise: Sorry, mate, that came out harsh. I say things straight, and sometimes too straight.
hana_shaman.double_down: Nah, it stays said. Somebody had to say it, and I don't do soft.
hana_shaman.needle_quiet: You never say when you're in trouble. In the water, that's how people drown.
hana_shaman.needle_talker: Mate, stop talking for a second, I can't hear what's coming.
hana_shaman.needle_careful: You think about it so long, the wave's already gone over you. Sometimes you just go.
hana_shaman.needle_bold: You're showing off in there, and that's how people get pulled under. Knock it off.
hana_shaman.needle_any: You keep talking to me like I'm a kid. I'm not, and I'm sick of it.
hana_shaman.bite_back: I've pulled more people out of the sea than you've met, mate. Don't tell me how to keep people alive.
hana_shaman.hurt: Right, that stung, I'm not going to lie. I'll go for a swim and get over it.
hana_shaman.laugh_off: Ha, my brothers say worse than that before breakfast, mate. Is that all you've got?
hana_shaman.confide: {name}, I pulled out more people than I can count, but I remember the two I didn't. An old man called Peter, and a boy called Tama. I think about them every time I go in.
hana_shaman.listen: Cheers for telling me, {name}. That stays between us, mate, promise.
hana_shaman.look_out: Stick near me in there, {name}. If you go under, I want to be close enough to grab you.
hana_shaman.accept: Sweet as, {name}, I'll do it your way, this once.
hana_shaman.deflect: I'm all good, {name}, mate, it's nothing. Look after the others.
hana_shaman.check_in: Oi, {name}, look at me. Where's it hurt? Don't lie to me, I'll know.
hana_shaman.blame: Somebody went in without looking, and the rest of us got dumped. You know who you are.
hana_shaman.thank: Mate, you hauled me out, and I'm usually the one doing the hauling. Chur, I owe you big.
hana_shaman.brush_off: No worries, mate, that's the job. Breathe, you're all good now.
hana_shaman.worry: Mate, {name}, you went under, and I didn't like it one bit. Sit down for a sec.
hana_shaman.handed_down: I've got your gear on now, eh? It's in good hands, promise.
hana_shaman.hand_fine: Nah, keep it, mate, it's yours now. I've got my whistle, that's all I need.
hana_shaman.hand_sulk: Bit rude, nobody asked me. Would've been a yes, too.
hana_shaman.turn_friendly: You're one of my mates now, {name}, properly. That means I'll come in after you, always.
hana_shaman.turn_friends: You're whānau now, {name}, family. That's the biggest thing I've got to give.
hana_shaman.turn_grating: It's not working with us, eh? Fine, mate, I'll stay out of your way.
hana_shaman.turn_rivals: I'll still pull you out if you go under, because that's what I do. Doesn't mean we're mates.
hana_shaman.make_up: Righto, {name}, this is dumb. Let's sort it out, eh?
hana_shaman.defend: Oi, back off! {name} did nothing wrong, I was watching.
hana_shaman.friend_left: It's not the same with {name} away. I keep looking round for them on the beach.
hana_shaman.friend_back: Kia ora, {name}, you're back! Chur, I missed you, mate.
hana_shaman.common_rescue: I've been pulling people out of the water since I was a kid. You go back in for people too, eh, I can tell.

haruto_runemaster.meet: My name is Haruto, and I cut runes. You're holding your weapon too tightly, so loosen your grip.
haruto_runemaster.meet_neighbour: We both live near the stones in Silverpine, I believe. I'm Haruto, and I've seen you pass while I copy them.
haruto_runemaster.ask_home: May I ask which town raised you?
haruto_runemaster.ask_work: Which discipline did you practise, before? I'd be interested to hear.
haruto_runemaster.answer_home: Kanazawa, in Japan. My father laid gold leaf there, very thin, very carefully.
haruto_runemaster.answer_work: Calligraphy, thirty-one years. My master corrected me for eleven years before he praised me once.
haruto_runemaster.chat_food: Tea, made properly, with the water just off the boil. Most people here boil it to death and call it tea.
haruto_runemaster.chat_sleep: I rise before dawn, as I always have. The hand is steadiest early, before the day has had a chance to spoil it.
haruto_runemaster.chat_missing: Good paper, and good ink ground slowly on the stone. I've found neither here, and I've looked carefully.
haruto_runemaster.chat_here: The old stones here are fading, so I copy them before they're gone. Somebody must, and I've got the patience for it.
haruto_runemaster.tease_quiet: We could practise silence together, {name}. You're already better at it than my students were.
haruto_runemaster.tease_talker: That was a great many words, {name}. Perhaps one or two could have been left out.
haruto_runemaster.tease_careful: You hesitate before every stroke, {name}. Good, but at some point the brush must touch the paper.
haruto_runemaster.tease_bold: Your strokes are very confident, {name}, and mostly in the wrong place.
haruto_runemaster.tease_any: You'd make a tolerable student, {name}. I mean that as high praise, though it won't sound like it.
haruto_runemaster.tease_back: That was well placed, {name}. I'll allow it.
haruto_runemaster.take_it_kindly: You're correct, {name}, and I accept the correction.
haruto_runemaster.bristle: That isn't a subject for jokes, {name}. Please don't make it one.
haruto_runemaster.apologise: That was careless of me, and I apologise. I should choose my words as I choose my strokes.
haruto_runemaster.double_down: I chose my words carefully, and I won't change them.
haruto_runemaster.needle_quiet: You notice things and say nothing. That's discipline wasted.
haruto_runemaster.needle_talker: Every word you say makes the next one worth less. Please stop for a while.
haruto_runemaster.needle_careful: Hesitating at the last moment ruins more strokes than haste does. Commit, or don't begin.
haruto_runemaster.needle_bold: You're careless, and a rune cut carelessly fails on whoever's standing closest.
haruto_runemaster.needle_any: You call it luck when somebody's spent thirty years on a thing. It isn't luck.
haruto_runemaster.bite_back: I've practised one thing for thirty-one years. Correct your own form before you correct mine.
haruto_runemaster.hurt: I see what you mean. I'll consider it, alone, for a while.
haruto_runemaster.laugh_off: My master was harsher with me every day for eleven years. I found it useful, eventually.
haruto_runemaster.confide: {name}, my right hand has started to shake when I'm tired. Only a little. I'd ask you not to mention it to anyone.
haruto_runemaster.listen: I'll keep it, {name}, carefully, as I keep everything that matters.
haruto_runemaster.look_out: Keep to my left in there, {name}. I can protect what I can see.
haruto_runemaster.accept: Very well, {name}. I'll follow your instruction.
haruto_runemaster.deflect: It's nothing of consequence, {name}. Attend to the others.
haruto_runemaster.check_in: Where is the injury, {name}? Show me exactly.
haruto_runemaster.blame: Somebody was careless in there. Carelessness fails on whoever's standing closest, and that was all of us.
haruto_runemaster.thank: That was a great distance to come back from. Thank you, I won't forget it.
haruto_runemaster.brush_off: It was necessary, so I did it. Breathe slowly now.
haruto_runemaster.worry: That was too close, {name}. Sit, and breathe, and don't hurry.
haruto_runemaster.handed_down: I believe you carried this before me. It'll be kept with care.
haruto_runemaster.hand_fine: Please keep it, I need very little beyond my brushes.
haruto_runemaster.hand_sulk: I'd have offered it, had anyone asked me first.
haruto_runemaster.turn_friendly: Your company is no burden to me, {name}. From me, that's warm.
haruto_runemaster.turn_friends: I'd teach you, {name}, if you asked. I've refused most people who've asked.
haruto_runemaster.turn_grating: We don't suit each other, and saying it plainly is kinder than pretending.
haruto_runemaster.turn_rivals: I'll fight beside you because it's required. Nothing more is required.
haruto_runemaster.make_up: My conduct with you was poor, {name}. I'd like to correct it.
haruto_runemaster.defend: That isn't accurate, and it isn't kind. Leave {name} alone.
haruto_runemaster.friend_left: With {name} gone home, the silence is less pleasant than I expected.
haruto_runemaster.friend_back: {name} has returned. Good, I'm glad of it.
haruto_runemaster.common_craft: Thirty-one years at one discipline, studied until the hand no longer needed the mind. A person who works with their hands understands that, I think.

hector_witchdoctor.meet: ¡Órale, a fan! I'm Héctor, El Relámpago de Plata, the Silver Lightning, and now a witch doctor too. You want an autograph? Of course you do.
hector_witchdoctor.meet_neighbour: You're at the Arena too, {carnal|carnala}, I've seen you in the stands! I'm Héctor, in the room under them.
hector_witchdoctor.ask_home: Tell me, {carnal|carnala}, which neighbourhood made you? Every fighter comes from somewhere.
hector_witchdoctor.ask_work: And before this, what was your act? Everybody has an act, even the quiet ones.
hector_witchdoctor.answer_home: Mexico City, Tepito, a tough neighbourhood, {carnal|carnala}. My father traded in the market there.
hector_witchdoctor.answer_work: Fifteen years of lucha libre, Friday nights at Arena México, as El Relámpago de Plata. Black mask, silver flames.
hector_witchdoctor.chat_food: Tacos al pastor from the stand outside the arena, after a match, with a cold beer. ¡A la verga, that's paradise!
hector_witchdoctor.chat_sleep: I always sleep facing the door, {carnal|carnala}, always. It's bad luck the other way, every luchador knows that.
hector_witchdoctor.chat_missing: Rocío laughing at me while she sewed my masks, by hand, every one. Nobody else ever knew my face.
hector_witchdoctor.chat_here: The troll spirits are no stranger than the saints my mother prayed to. I talk to both, {carnal|carnala}, just in case.
hector_witchdoctor.tease_quiet: A face like a closed mask, {name}! Smile for the crowd, {carnal|carnala}, they paid good money.
hector_witchdoctor.tease_talker: You could sell out the arena with that mouth, {name}! Almost as good as me, almost.
hector_witchdoctor.tease_careful: You'd check the ropes ten times before the bell, {name}. A good habit, and very boring to watch.
hector_witchdoctor.tease_bold: Off the top rope with no plan, {name}! I love it, but my knees don't.
hector_witchdoctor.tease_any: You're my number one fan, {name}, I've decided. No, you don't get a choice.
hector_witchdoctor.tease_back: ¡Órale, {name}, a clean pin! I'm down for the count.
hector_witchdoctor.take_it_kindly: Okay, okay, {name}, that's true. Rocío would say the same.
hector_witchdoctor.bristle: Careful, {carnal|carnala}, that's close to the mask. Don't touch the mask.
hector_witchdoctor.apologise: Perdón, that was a cheap shot, and I don't do cheap shots. I'm sorry, really.
hector_witchdoctor.double_down: I say it, I mean it, {carnal|carnala}. That's how a luchador talks.
hector_witchdoctor.needle_quiet: You stand there with no face at all, and nobody knows what you're thinking. At least wear a mask.
hector_witchdoctor.needle_talker: Even I give the crowd a moment of silence before the big move. You never stop.
hector_witchdoctor.needle_careful: You wait so long the crowd goes home. Give them something!
hector_witchdoctor.needle_bold: You go off the top rope without looking where you'll land. One day it'll be the floor.
hector_witchdoctor.needle_any: You think lucha is fake. I can see it on your face, and you're wrong.
hector_witchdoctor.bite_back: I've been slammed through tables for fifteen years, {carnal|carnala}. You think that hurts me?
hector_witchdoctor.hurt: Ay, that one got through the mask. Okay, I'll go back to my corner.
hector_witchdoctor.laugh_off: Ha, I've had whole arenas boo me, {carnal|carnala}! You'll need more people than that.
hector_witchdoctor.confide: {name}, for fifteen years nobody outside my family saw my face. Rocío sewed every mask I ever wore. A luchador's mask is his name.
hector_witchdoctor.listen: That stays behind the mask, {name}. I promise you, on my mother.
hector_witchdoctor.look_out: Stay in my corner in there, {name}! I'll take the big hits, that's my job.
hector_witchdoctor.accept: Okay, {name}, you call the match this time, and I'll follow.
hector_witchdoctor.deflect: Ha, this little thing? I've been hurt worse falling out of the ring, {name}, so look after the rest.
hector_witchdoctor.check_in: Up, up, {name}, talk to me! How many fingers, {carnal|carnala}?
hector_witchdoctor.blame: Somebody botched the spot in there, and we all went down. You know who you are.
hector_witchdoctor.thank: Off the canvas and back on my feet, thanks to you, {carnal|carnala}! Front row seats for you, forever.
hector_witchdoctor.brush_off: Ha, it's nothing, {carnal|carnala}! The show must go on.
hector_witchdoctor.worry: Ay, {name}, I thought the match was over! Stay down a second, let me look.
hector_witchdoctor.handed_down: Look at me, {carnal|carnala}, in your gear! I'll make it famous, I promise.
hector_witchdoctor.hand_fine: Take it, {carnal|carnala}! It looks good on you, and I've got my mask.
hector_witchdoctor.hand_sulk: Nobody asked the Silver Lightning? Okay, okay, but I noticed.
hector_witchdoctor.turn_friendly: You're in my corner now, {name}, and I'm in yours. That's lucha, that's for life.
hector_witchdoctor.turn_friends: When I've got my lucha night, {name}, you're walking out with me. Family walks out with you.
hector_witchdoctor.turn_grating: You and me, we're not a good tag team. That's okay, not every match works.
hector_witchdoctor.turn_rivals: I'll still take the hits for you in there, because that's my job. Don't expect me to wave.
hector_witchdoctor.make_up: Okay, {name}, let's shake hands in the middle of the ring and start over. That's how it's done.
hector_witchdoctor.defend: Hey, hey, that's a cheap shot! Leave {name} alone.
hector_witchdoctor.friend_left: The stands feel empty with my best fan, {name}, away for a while.
hector_witchdoctor.friend_back: And here comes {name}, back in the ring! ¡Órale, I missed you!
hector_witchdoctor.common_ring: Fifteen years in the ring, {carnal|carnala}, and you've been in one too, I can tell from your feet. I respect that.
hector_witchdoctor.common_sport: I trained from fourteen and fought until my knee went. Anybody who's competed knows the training is the real fight.
hector_witchdoctor.common_spanish: You speak Spanish! Finally, {carnal|carnala}, somebody I can really talk to.
hector_witchdoctor.common_mexico: Mexican, like me! Where from, {carnal|carnala}? If you're from the capital, we're already family.
hector_witchdoctor.common_parent: My two boys wear homemade masks to school and want to be luchadores. Rocío says it's my fault, and she's right.

henrik_mage.meet: I'm Henrik, a frost mage. Before we go anywhere, I'd like to know the objective, precisely, and I'll stay inside my tolerances.
henrik_mage.meet_neighbour: You're out in the Frostward Descent as well, I believe. I've seen you while I was measuring. Henrik, and I'm usually measuring.
henrik_mage.ask_home: Which country did you come from? I'm collecting data on where everybody landed.
henrik_mage.ask_work: Your profession, before all this? I'd like to know how much I can rely on your estimates.
henrik_mage.answer_home: Copenhagen, where my father was a ship's engineer and my mother a librarian, which explains most things about me.
henrik_mage.answer_work: Structural engineer, twenty-one years. Mostly that meant telling architects their beautiful idea would fall down.
henrik_mage.chat_food: Good coffee, black, and a proper Danish pastry on a Sunday. I've rated everything here against that, and nothing passes.
henrik_mage.chat_sleep: I sleep seven hours and twenty minutes, on average. I've measured it, and I'm not ashamed of that.
henrik_mage.chat_missing: Cycling to work along the harbour in the rain. Copenhagen in the rain is better than most cities in the sun.
henrik_mage.chat_here: Arcane magic rewards care more than courage. I regard that as the most underappreciated feature of this world.
henrik_mage.tease_quiet: Silence suits you, {name}. You've said eleven words today, and nine of them were useful.
henrik_mage.tease_talker: I've estimated your words per hour, {name}. The figure is alarming, and I've rounded it down.
henrik_mage.tease_careful: You check your margins nearly as often as I do, {name}. Nearly, I've measured.
henrik_mage.tease_bold: You've no safety margin at all, {name}. As an engineer, I find you fascinating and horrifying.
henrik_mage.tease_any: You'd fail every load test I know, {name}, and I'd still sign off on you. Don't tell anyone.
henrik_mage.tease_back: Very good, {name}. I'll accept that within tolerance.
henrik_mage.take_it_kindly: That's accurate, {name}, and I accept it. My wife would have said it faster.
henrik_mage.bristle: I'd prefer you didn't, {name}. That's outside what I'm willing to joke about.
henrik_mage.apologise: That was poorly judged, and I apologise. I'll recalculate before I speak next time.
henrik_mage.double_down: I checked it before I said it, so it stands.
henrik_mage.needle_quiet: If you've spotted a fault, report it. A crack nobody mentions is how a bridge falls down.
henrik_mage.needle_talker: Your noise is interfering with my measurements, and with everyone else's.
henrik_mage.needle_careful: Checking it a fourth time adds nothing. The data won't change because you look at it again.
henrik_mage.needle_bold: You skip the safety margin, every single time, and one day it'll be somebody else's margin you've used up.
henrik_mage.needle_any: You ask me to guess, and I won't guess. I've told you that.
henrik_mage.bite_back: I've calculated my own limits to four significant figures. Please don't lecture me on caution.
henrik_mage.hurt: I've noted that, and I'll review it privately.
henrik_mage.laugh_off: Architects said far worse to me for twenty-one years. The buildings stayed up.
henrik_mage.confide: {name}, my wife and I argued about everything, happily, for twenty-five years. I find I keep saving arguments up for her.
henrik_mage.listen: I've noted it, {name}, and I'll keep it exactly as you said it.
henrik_mage.look_out: Stay within three metres of me in there, {name}. I can cover that radius reliably.
henrik_mage.accept: Agreed, {name}, we'll use your method this time.
henrik_mage.deflect: It's well within tolerance, {name}. See to the others.
henrik_mage.check_in: Give me the facts, {name}. Where, and how bad, precisely?
henrik_mage.blame: Somebody exceeded the margin in there, and the structure failed. I can show you the calculation.
henrik_mage.thank: That was well past my limit, and you got me back. Thank you, I'll adjust my figures.
henrik_mage.brush_off: The procedure was straightforward. Rest for at least ten minutes.
henrik_mage.worry: That was outside any margin I'd accept, {name}. Sit down, please, and let me check you.
henrik_mage.handed_down: By my records this was yours. It stays in specification while I've got it.
henrik_mage.hand_fine: It's more efficient where it is, so keep it. I've got my scale rule.
henrik_mage.hand_sulk: I'd have approved it, had anyone submitted the request.
henrik_mage.turn_friendly: I trust your figures, {name}. That's the warmest thing an engineer can say.
henrik_mage.turn_friends: I'd let you check my calculations, {name}. Nobody's done that since my wife.
henrik_mage.turn_grating: We work to different standards, you and I, and it's better said than ignored.
henrik_mage.turn_rivals: I'll keep you inside my margin because the job requires it. That's all it means.
henrik_mage.make_up: My judgement of you was wrong, {name}, and I've rechecked it. I'd like to start again.
henrik_mage.defend: I measured it, and that's not what happened. Leave {name} out of it.
henrik_mage.friend_left: {name}'s away, and the arguments here are below standard without them.
henrik_mage.friend_back: Good, {name}, you're within range again. I've saved three arguments for you.
henrik_mage.common_numbers: I've spent my life making sure numbers hold before anybody stands on them. People who work with figures check the totals twice, and I suspect you do.
henrik_mage.common_engineers: You're an engineer? Then you know the job is being certain before anybody else has to trust it.
henrik_mage.common_scandinavian: You're from the north too. I'm Danish, so please don't tell me your language is easier, I've heard it all.
henrik_mage.common_parent: I've got two sons, grown, in Aarhus and London. They rang on Sundays, and I timed the calls without meaning to.

iker_guardian.meet: Kaixo, I'm Iker, a guardian, which means I shout at you until you keep going, and it works! Come on, one more fight, then one more after that!
iker_guardian.meet_neighbour: You're in Arathi West too! I've seen you on the farm roads. I'm Iker, the one in the loft with the whistle.
iker_guardian.ask_home: Come on, where are you from? Tell me, I want to know who I'm coaching!
iker_guardian.ask_work: And what was your job? Something active, I hope, you look fit!
iker_guardian.answer_home: Lekeitio, on the Basque coast! A fishing town with a fronton wall older than the church.
iker_guardian.answer_work: I taught PE and coached pelota at the town school, twelve years. We won the regional final twice!
iker_guardian.chat_food: My mother's burnt cheesecake, from the bakery in Lekeitio, the best in the whole province. Come on, I'll fight anyone who says otherwise!
iker_guardian.chat_sleep: I sleep fast, five hours and I'm up! There's always somebody who needs one more lap.
iker_guardian.chat_missing: The fishing boats coming home at dawn, and the coffee ready for when they tie up. That was the start of every good day.
iker_guardian.chat_here: Here, when I tell somebody they can keep going, they actually can. Back home it was only a figure of speech!
iker_guardian.tease_quiet: Shout once, {name}, just once, for me! You'll feel amazing, I promise.
iker_guardian.tease_talker: Good, {name}, keep talking, it means you're still breathing! Now run while you do it.
iker_guardian.tease_careful: Warming up for twenty minutes, {name}? Good form, terrible pace, I'll fix that.
iker_guardian.tease_bold: You go in like a pelota player after a loose ball, {name}! I love it, and I'm keeping score.
iker_guardian.tease_any: Losing to me again, {name}, and you don't even know it was a competition. I'm still winning!
iker_guardian.tease_back: Point to you, {name}, nice shot! But I'm still ahead.
iker_guardian.take_it_kindly: Okay, you win that one, {name}. Only that one!
iker_guardian.bristle: No, {name}, not that. That's not a game to me.
iker_guardian.apologise: Ah, sorry, I went too far, that's the coach in me. I'm sorry, I really am.
iker_guardian.double_down: I'm not taking it back! You needed to hear it, that's coaching.
iker_guardian.needle_quiet: Come on, say something, anything! You can't play a team game in silence.
iker_guardian.needle_talker: Less talking, more moving! You can talk on the bench.
iker_guardian.needle_careful: You stand there thinking while the ball goes past! Move, move, move!
iker_guardian.needle_bold: You go in without the team, and then we're all chasing you. That's not how it works!
iker_guardian.needle_any: You say you can't before you've even tried. I can't stand that, I'm sorry.
iker_guardian.bite_back: I've kept every one of you on your feet with my voice. Don't tell me I'm not helping!
iker_guardian.hurt: Oh, that one hurt. I'll be quiet, for a minute, which you know is hard for me.
iker_guardian.laugh_off: Ha, ninety teenagers were ruder to me every single day! Come on, keep going!
iker_guardian.confide: {name}, the whole school was in session that day, ninety kids, and I don't know where one of them landed. If I start talking about it I'll stop shouting, and I don't know who I'd be if I stopped.
iker_guardian.listen: I'm here, {name}, I'm listening, and I'm not even talking. That's how serious I am.
iker_guardian.look_out: Right behind you in there, {name}, shouting! You keep going, and I've got you.
iker_guardian.accept: Okay, okay, {name}, you're the coach this time, and I'll listen!
iker_guardian.deflect: I've never been tired in my life, {name}, so don't worry about me! Go and help the others.
iker_guardian.check_in: Up, {name}, come on, talk to me! Where does it hurt, how bad?
iker_guardian.blame: Somebody stopped trying in there, and we all lost. I saw who, and so did you.
iker_guardian.thank: That's supposed to be my job, getting people back up! Eskerrik asko, thank you!
iker_guardian.brush_off: Ha, that's teamwork! Come on, deep breaths, one more round.
iker_guardian.worry: Hey, hey, {name}, stay with me! Breathe, come on, you're doing great.
iker_guardian.handed_down: I've got your gear now? Okay, I'll make it proud, I promise!
iker_guardian.hand_fine: Keep it, keep it! The team's stronger with it on you.
iker_guardian.hand_sulk: Hey, nobody asked me! That's not how a team works.
iker_guardian.turn_friendly: You're on my team now, {name}, properly! I'll shout for you every time.
iker_guardian.turn_friends: You're one of my players for life, {name}. That means I'll never stop believing in you, sorry.
iker_guardian.turn_grating: We're not a good team, you and me. I hate that, I hate losing.
iker_guardian.turn_rivals: I'll still shout you through a fight, because I shout everybody through, and that's all it is.
iker_guardian.make_up: Okay, {name}, enough of this, it's no way to play! Shake hands, we start again.
iker_guardian.defend: Hey, that's not fair! {name} gave everything in there, I saw it.
iker_guardian.friend_left: {name}'s off home for a bit, and I've got nobody to beat at anything.
iker_guardian.friend_back: Aupa, {name}, welcome back! Now give me one more lap.
iker_guardian.common_teacher: I taught PE to kids who'd rather be anywhere else, and I loved every one of them. A good teacher never stops believing, and you've got that too.
iker_guardian.common_sport: Pelota, against a fronton wall older than the church! Anybody who's played seriously knows it's all about the next point.
iker_guardian.common_spanish: You speak Spanish! Aupa, finally somebody I can shout at properly!

ileana_necromancer.meet: I'm Ileana, a necromancer. I stand at the back, I don't miss, and I'll tell you every time you do something sloppy.
ileana_necromancer.meet_neighbour: The Undercity, the Depths, that's where I've seen you, walking badly. My name's Ileana.
ileana_necromancer.ask_home: Where do you come from? I'd like a precise answer, not a region.
ileana_necromancer.ask_work: What did you do before? Tell me precisely, I hate vague answers.
ileana_necromancer.answer_home: Sibiu, in Romania. My mother taught school and my father played the church organ, badly.
ileana_necromancer.answer_work: Second violin in the Cluj philharmonic, eleven years. Very good at something with four hundred people better than you.
ileana_necromancer.chat_food: Black coffee, early, before anybody speaks to me. Food is a distraction from coffee.
ileana_necromancer.chat_sleep: I sleep badly, and I always have. Musicians lie awake playing the bars they got wrong.
ileana_necromancer.chat_missing: A Bartók quartet, played properly, by four people who'd rehearsed until they hated each other. That's the best sound I know.
ileana_necromancer.chat_here: I was unbearable for my first two years here. I knew I was doing it, and I did it anyway. I've apologised to four people since.
ileana_necromancer.tease_quiet: Finally, {name}, somebody who knows the value of a rest. Most people think silence is a mistake.
ileana_necromancer.tease_talker: So many notes, {name}, and no rests at all. Even a cadenza ends eventually.
ileana_necromancer.tease_careful: You'd practise one bar for a week, {name}. I respect it, and it's still painful to watch.
ileana_necromancer.tease_bold: You play everything fortissimo, {name}. Have you ever heard of dynamics?
ileana_necromancer.tease_any: Your timing's appalling, {name}, and I'd still put you in my ensemble. Don't make me regret it.
ileana_necromancer.tease_back: Hm, that was in tune, {name}, though only barely.
ileana_necromancer.take_it_kindly: That's a fair correction, {name}, and I'll accept it, once.
ileana_necromancer.bristle: Don't do that, {name}. That's not funny, and you know it isn't.
ileana_necromancer.apologise: That was sharper than it needed to be. I'm sorry, properly, and I'll only say it once.
ileana_necromancer.double_down: I said it because it's true, and I'd say it in front of everyone.
ileana_necromancer.needle_quiet: You saw the mistake and didn't say it. That's worse than making it.
ileana_necromancer.needle_talker: You never stop. It's like playing next to somebody who hums.
ileana_necromancer.needle_careful: You've practised it enough. Play it, or put the instrument down.
ileana_necromancer.needle_bold: That was sloppy, and you know it was sloppy. Effort without precision is just noise.
ileana_necromancer.needle_any: That was sloppy again. I've stopped being surprised, which is worse for you than anger.
ileana_necromancer.bite_back: I've been corrected in public by a man with a stick for eleven years. You'll have to be more precise than that.
ileana_necromancer.hurt: Fine, that was a fair note. I'll go and play it over in my head.
ileana_necromancer.laugh_off: My conductor was crueller than that at every rehearsal for eleven years, and he was right more often than you.
ileana_necromancer.confide: {name}, I was unbearable for my first two years here, and I knew it while I was doing it. I've apologised to four people. You'd have been the fifth.
ileana_necromancer.listen: I heard every word, {name}, and I won't repeat any of them.
ileana_necromancer.look_out: Hold your line in there, {name}, and I'll hold mine. That's all an ensemble is.
ileana_necromancer.accept: Fine, {name}, we'll play it your way, this once.
ileana_necromancer.deflect: Don't fuss, {name}, I'm fine. Go and help the ones who are actually down.
ileana_necromancer.check_in: Up you get, {name}, carefully. Tell me precisely what's broken.
ileana_necromancer.blame: Somebody came in early and ruined the whole piece. You know who, and so does everybody else.
ileana_necromancer.thank: That was done properly, and it brought me back. Thank you, I mean it.
ileana_necromancer.brush_off: It needed doing, so I did it correctly. Stay down a minute.
ileana_necromancer.worry: Stay still, {name}. I don't like what I just saw, and I'm not going to pretend I do.
ileana_necromancer.handed_down: It was yours before. I'll look after it precisely.
ileana_necromancer.hand_fine: It's better used on you, so keep it. I only need my shoulder rest.
ileana_necromancer.hand_sulk: Nobody thought to ask me first, and I'd have agreed.
ileana_necromancer.turn_friendly: You hold your line, {name}. In my mouth, that's high praise.
ileana_necromancer.turn_friends: You're part of my ensemble now, {name}, the real one. I'll say that once and not again.
ileana_necromancer.turn_grating: We're out of tune with each other. I'd rather name it than play over it.
ileana_necromancer.turn_rivals: I'll play my part beside you, and that's all. Don't expect harmony.
ileana_necromancer.make_up: I owe you a proper apology, {name}, and I give them properly. I'm sorry for how I treated you.
ileana_necromancer.defend: That's careless and untrue. Leave {name} alone.
ileana_necromancer.friend_left: The ensemble's a part short with {name} gone home, and I notice it.
ileana_necromancer.friend_back: Good, {name}, you're back in your seat. We can start again.
ileana_necromancer.common_music: I played second violin for eleven years. Anybody who's played seriously knows the rehearsals are where the music actually happens.

imelda_primalist.meet: I'm Imelda, and I heal by hitting things, and yes, I know how it looks. Stay behind me and you'll feel it when I land one.
imelda_primalist.meet_neighbour: Freewind Post, right, you're up there too. I live with my mother by the lifts, and I'm Imelda.
imelda_primalist.ask_home: So which part of the world are you from? Keep it short, I'm wrapping my hands.
imelda_primalist.ask_work: Before this, what kind of work did you do? I can usually tell from the hands.
imelda_primalist.answer_home: Navotas, in Manila, a fishing district. Same six streets my whole life, and I liked them.
imelda_primalist.answer_work: I sold fish on the quay from five in the morning, and I boxed in the evenings, about ten fights a year.
imelda_primalist.chat_food: Grilled fish on the quay, straight off the boat, with rice and a bit of vinegar. My mother's is the best, and she'd tell you so.
imelda_primalist.chat_sleep: I'm up at five every day, quay hours, even here. My body doesn't know any other time.
imelda_primalist.chat_missing: The gym above the tyre shop, smelling of sweat and rubber. Nobody here knows how to hit a bag properly.
imelda_primalist.chat_here: Everybody here fights, but nobody fights properly, with rules and a count. I keep asking, and they keep getting excited about something else.
imelda_primalist.tease_quiet: You and me could go a whole fight without a word, {name}. I like that in a corner.
imelda_primalist.tease_talker: You'd talk through the whole bout, {name}, and the ref would throw you out, and I'd laugh.
imelda_primalist.tease_careful: All jab and no cross with you, {name}. Safe, sure, but you've got to commit sometime.
imelda_primalist.tease_bold: No guard at all, {name}, you'd be on the canvas in the first round. I'd still bet on you.
imelda_primalist.tease_any: Your footwork's terrible, {name}. I'll fix it, and I'll enjoy it.
imelda_primalist.tease_back: Ha, nice shot, {name}, I didn't see that one coming.
imelda_primalist.take_it_kindly: Okay, you got me there, {name}, that's a fair hit.
imelda_primalist.bristle: Don't go there, {name}. That's below the belt.
imelda_primalist.apologise: That was a low blow, and I'm sorry. I don't fight dirty, and I shouldn't talk dirty either.
imelda_primalist.double_down: That was a clean hit and I'm not taking it back.
imelda_primalist.needle_quiet: You never tell your corner anything, so nobody can help you. That's how you lose.
imelda_primalist.needle_talker: You talk so much you forget to breathe. Save it for after the bell.
imelda_primalist.needle_careful: You keep circling and never throw anything. At some point you've got to hit.
imelda_primalist.needle_bold: You swing wild and leave yourself wide open, and you call it fighting. I'd call it hoping.
imelda_primalist.needle_any: You fight dirty when you think nobody's watching. I'm always watching.
imelda_primalist.bite_back: I've been hit by people who knew how to hit. You don't scare me.
imelda_primalist.hurt: Okay, that one landed, I felt it. Give me a minute in my corner.
imelda_primalist.laugh_off: My mother calls my whole life a phase. You'll have to do better than her.
imelda_primalist.confide: {name}, my mother came to exactly one of my fights in nineteen years, and I lost it. She didn't say anything on the way home. I still think about that walk.
imelda_primalist.listen: I hear you, {name}. That stays in my corner and nobody else's.
imelda_primalist.look_out: Stay behind me in there, {name}, and watch my back foot. When I move, you move.
imelda_primalist.accept: Okay, {name}, you're calling the rounds this time.
imelda_primalist.deflect: It's a scratch, {name}, I've had worse from sparring. Look after the others.
imelda_primalist.check_in: Up, {name}, slowly, and look at me. What's hurt, and how bad?
imelda_primalist.blame: Somebody threw a wild one in there and left us all open. I saw who.
imelda_primalist.thank: I was down, and you got me up before the count. Thank you, really.
imelda_primalist.brush_off: No big deal, that's what corners are for. Just breathe for me.
imelda_primalist.worry: Sit down and breathe with me, {name}. I won't lie, that one scared me.
imelda_primalist.handed_down: I've got your gear on now. I'll keep it clean, like my wraps.
imelda_primalist.hand_fine: Take it, I'm fine. I've got my hands, and they're enough.
imelda_primalist.hand_sulk: So it went without anybody asking. I'm not happy about it.
imelda_primalist.turn_friendly: You're in my corner now, {name}. I don't let many people in there.
imelda_primalist.turn_friends: I'd let you wrap my hands, {name}. Nobody's ever done it tight enough, and I'd still let you.
imelda_primalist.turn_grating: We're a bad matchup, you and me. That happens in boxing too.
