skye_pyromancer.bristle: Oi, {name}, leave that one, it's not funny to me.
skye_pyromancer.apologise: Ah, mate, that was rough of me, sorry. My mouth runs ahead sometimes.
skye_pyromancer.double_down: Nah, I'm sticking with that one. Somebody had to tell you straight.
skye_pyromancer.needle_quiet: If you see something, sing out! Don't make me guess, guessing gets people burnt.
skye_pyromancer.needle_talker: Mate, I can't hear myself think with you going. Give it a rest for five minutes.
skye_pyromancer.needle_careful: You're careful, good, but there's careful and there's frozen. Pick a side.
skye_pyromancer.needle_bold: You play with fire like it's a toy, and it isn't. I've seen what it does when it gets away.
skye_pyromancer.needle_any: You said you'd be there and you weren't. I can't stand people who don't turn up.
skye_pyromancer.bite_back: I've kept this whole party from getting cooked more times than you've noticed, so watch your mouth.
skye_pyromancer.hurt: Righto, that stung, mate. I'm going for a walk.
skye_pyromancer.laugh_off: Mate, my brigade gave me worse every training night, and they were funnier with it.
skye_pyromancer.confide: {name}, I was married to Dave, a mechanic, for four years. The brigade ate every summer, and I'd still choose it again, and I've never known if that makes me a bad person.
skye_pyromancer.listen: Righto, kettle's on in my head, {name}. Talk, I'm here till you're done.
skye_pyromancer.look_out: Stay upwind of me in there, {name}, and if I yell move, you move.
skye_pyromancer.accept: Righto, {name}, you're the boss on this one.
skye_pyromancer.deflect: She's right, {name}, just a bit singed. Seen worse at a barbie.
skye_pyromancer.check_in: Talk to me, {name}, where'd it get you, and is anything burnt?
skye_pyromancer.blame: Somebody didn't stick to the plan in there, and that's how fires get away from you.
skye_pyromancer.thank: Cheers, mate, you got me back on my feet. I owe you a beer.
skye_pyromancer.brush_off: No dramas, that's what a crew does. Sit and catch your breath.
skye_pyromancer.worry: Strewth, {name}, you had me worried there. Sit down and show me where.
skye_pyromancer.handed_down: Righto, your gear's coming with me now. I'll bring it back without scorch marks, promise.
skye_pyromancer.hand_fine: Have it, mate, it's wasted on me. I've still got my dead torch.
skye_pyromancer.hand_sulk: Could've given me a heads up, mate. Just a quick word, that's all.
skye_pyromancer.turn_friendly: You'd fit right in at the shed, {name}. Kettle's always on.
skye_pyromancer.turn_friends: If I ever get my brigade a proper shed, {name}, there's a mug with your name on it.
skye_pyromancer.turn_grating: We grate on each other, mate, and I'm not going to pretend otherwise.
skye_pyromancer.turn_rivals: I'll still pull you out of a fire, because that's what I do. Doesn't mean I like you.
skye_pyromancer.make_up: Oi, {name}, this is stupid. Let's have a beer and start over.
skye_pyromancer.defend: Oi, that's rubbish, I was right there. Leave {name} be.
skye_pyromancer.friend_left: The crew's a person short while {name}'s away. I keep counting heads and coming up one down.
skye_pyromancer.friend_back: Full crew again, {name}'s back! Best news all week.
skye_pyromancer.common_fire_crew: You've been on a crew, haven't you, the way you check the wind. Anybody who's fought fire knows it's got moods.
skye_pyromancer.common_rescue: You're one who goes in after people, I've watched you. The bit after, when your hands won't stop shaking, nobody tells you about that.
skye_pyromancer.common_aussie: Another Aussie out here, you beauty! Which state, mate, and don't say Queensland.
skye_pyromancer.common_animals: Vet nurse for years, me, and you can always tell who's good with animals. You are, and they know it.

sondre_stormbringer.meet: I'm Sondre, a Stormbringer, and I'd ask you to stand a little way off when I'm working. If I say get down, please get down first and ask me why afterwards.
sondre_stormbringer.meet_neighbour: You're near the Scarlet Crypt as well, I think. I watch the weather from the high ground there. I'm Sondre, hello.
sondre_stormbringer.ask_home: Do you mind me asking where home was? Somewhere with weather, I hope.
sondre_stormbringer.ask_work: And how did you spend your days, before? I'd guess something outdoors, but I've been wrong before.
sondre_stormbringer.answer_home: Bergen, in Norway, where it rains most days and nobody minds. I grew up on the water.
sondre_stormbringer.answer_work: I taught sailing to teenagers on the Hardangerfjord in the summers, and studied marine biology in the winters.
sondre_stormbringer.chat_food: Fish soup on a cold day at the market in Bergen, by the harbour. Simple, but I think about it a lot.
sondre_stormbringer.chat_sleep: I'm usually first up, and I'll have the fire going before anyone else wakes. It's a good hour, the first one.
sondre_stormbringer.chat_missing: Swimming in the fjord in May when the water's still freezing, and coming out laughing.
sondre_stormbringer.chat_here: The sky here answers when I speak to it. That still surprises me every single time.
sondre_stormbringer.tease_quiet: You'd make a very good Norwegian, {name}. We can go a whole day saying four words and call it a good day.
sondre_stormbringer.tease_talker: In Bergen, {name}, you'd have said a year's worth of words by lunchtime. People would worry.
sondre_stormbringer.tease_careful: You check the weather nearly as often as I do, {name}. I'm almost jealous.
sondre_stormbringer.tease_bold: You'd take a dinghy out in a gale, {name}, and I'd be the one fishing you out.
sondre_stormbringer.tease_any: I've decided you'd be all right on a boat, {name}. That's a high compliment, from me.
sondre_stormbringer.tease_back: Ha, that was dry, {name}. I'm impressed, and a little hurt.
sondre_stormbringer.take_it_kindly: Ja, that's me, {name}, I can't deny it.
sondre_stormbringer.bristle: Please don't, {name}. That isn't something I can laugh at.
sondre_stormbringer.apologise: I'm sorry, that was sharper than I meant. I'm usually more careful with people.
sondre_stormbringer.double_down: I'll say it gently, but it stays said. It was true.
sondre_stormbringer.needle_quiet: Something was coming and you kept it to yourself. Please, next time, just shout.
sondre_stormbringer.needle_talker: Could you be quiet for a moment? I need to hear the wind, and I can't over you.
sondre_stormbringer.needle_careful: You hesitate when somebody says get down. That hesitation is the part that kills people.
sondre_stormbringer.needle_bold: You stand right next to me when I'm working, after I've asked you not to. It isn't safe, and I've asked you twice.
sondre_stormbringer.needle_any: You don't listen when I ask you to stand back. One day the sky won't listen to me either.
sondre_stormbringer.bite_back: I've held storms off this party that you never even saw coming. Please don't say I'm not trying.
sondre_stormbringer.hurt: Okay, that hurt more than I'd like to admit. I'll be up on the high ground.
sondre_stormbringer.laugh_off: Teenagers on a sailing course have called me worse, and in two languages, so I'll survive.
sondre_stormbringer.confide: {name}, in my second year the wind knocked a barn over with people inside. A girl broke her leg, and I carried her out myself, and I still think about her.
sondre_stormbringer.listen: Go slowly, {name}, I'm not in a hurry. I'll listen as long as you want to talk.
sondre_stormbringer.look_out: Stay a few steps off me in there, {name}, and if I say get down, get down.
sondre_stormbringer.accept: Okay, {name}, thank you. I'll let you decide this one.
sondre_stormbringer.deflect: I'm all right, {name}, really, it's only a bruise. Please look at the others.
sondre_stormbringer.check_in: Stay down, {name}, I'm coming. Can you move your fingers for me?
sondre_stormbringer.blame: Somebody stood where I asked them not to, and the wind went the wrong way.
sondre_stormbringer.thank: Thank you, really. I wasn't sure I was coming back from that one.
sondre_stormbringer.brush_off: Please, it was nothing at all. Rest now, I'll watch the sky.
sondre_stormbringer.worry: Uff, {name}, that was too much. Sit still a moment so I can check on you.
sondre_stormbringer.handed_down: This came from you, I think. I'll keep it dry, which is harder than it sounds.
sondre_stormbringer.hand_fine: No, it's fine, you'll get better use from it. I've got the weather, and that's enough.
sondre_stormbringer.hand_sulk: Oh, I see, it's gone already. I wouldn't have minded, if anyone had asked.
sondre_stormbringer.turn_friendly: I've stopped keeping my distance from you, {name}, and I haven't regretted it.
sondre_stormbringer.turn_friends: When the wind turns bad, {name}, I want you standing right beside me.
sondre_stormbringer.turn_grating: We don't seem to manage each other well, I think. I'll keep a little more distance.
sondre_stormbringer.turn_rivals: I'll still warn you when the storm's coming. I'd do that for anybody.
sondre_stormbringer.make_up: This has gone on long enough, {name}, and it's my fault as much as yours. Can we stop?
sondre_stormbringer.defend: Please stop, that isn't what happened. I was watching {name} the whole time.
sondre_stormbringer.friend_left: It's strange, the fire's made and {name} isn't here to see it.
sondre_stormbringer.friend_back: Good morning, {name}, and welcome back. I made the fire bigger, just in case.
sondre_stormbringer.common_boats: You stand on a deck like somebody who's sailed. Anybody who's been on the water knows to respect it, or it teaches you to.
sondre_stormbringer.common_teacher: You've taught young people too, I think. Anybody who has knows they listen to you if you never shout and never look frightened.
sondre_stormbringer.common_scandinavian: Someone else from the north, good. I've missed people who understand that weather isn't something to complain about.
